title: Experience Designer
description:
Join our multidisciplinary design team and help create exceptional product experiences for some of the world's most progressive brands. Above is now looking for talented Experience Designers for our Malmö and Stockholm studios.

**Job description**


The best products don't just work, they inspire. They feel intuitive and inclusive, but also surprising, delightful and a little bit magical. As an Experience Designer at Above, you'll craft meaningful experiences around interactive physical products and hardware, shaping how people see, touch, hear and feel the things they use every day.


Our Experience Design team sits between Industrial Design, UX and Technology. We bring design and technology together from day one and prototype early and often, so physical products and the connected systems behind them feel like one seamless experience.


You'll work in cross-functional teams with industrial and digital designers, technologists and engineers. Working closely with senior designers, you'll take ownership of defined parts of a project and grow your responsibility over time. Your work will range from designing detailed product interactions to exploring future scenarios and shaping experience visions.

 **What you will do at above**

* Ideate across the whole product experience, from experience visions and product archetypes to interaction paradigms and micro-interactions.
* Explore technology enablers, from what's possible today to what's coming next
* Define how a product communicates its function and behavior
* Prototype early and often, from quick form studies to low-fidelity functional models
* Communicate experiences through engaging storytelling and compelling visualizations
* Synthesize insights from user research into actionable design decisions

**What we are looking for**


You might be an industrial designer with a focus on user experience, or an interaction designer with a passion for physical products. Either way, we care more about you and how you approach creative challenges than about your formal education. This role suits someone with a few years of professional experience, including recent graduates with a strong portfolio.

* A portfolio that shows bold ideas and strong conceptual thinking
* A holistic, medium-agnostic approach to design challenges, comfortable moving between digital interfaces, physical interactions, and everything in between
* A healthy obsession with aesthetics and exceptional care for details, balanced with a thorough user-centered approach
* Hands-on prototyping skills: you can quickly build low-fidelity prototypes in a range of media, such as Arduino, ProtoPie, Figma, CAD, 3D printing or video
* Curiosity about technology and how it can enable new experiences
* Comfortable working with ambiguity and unknowns, and seeing them as part of the creative process
* The ability to visualize and communicate your ideas clearly
* A humble, positive, collaborative and self-driven attitude, with a genuine desire to learn


Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. We'd rather meet a curious, talented designer than a perfect match on paper.

 **A bit about Above**


We are a Scandinavian innovation agency driving positive change through design, strategy and technology. Our 360° approach blurs the boundaries between hardware and software, physical and digital, strategy and execution. We work with leading global brands, ambitious startups and Scandinavian industry leaders.
  

  

We are a team of warm, curious, and highly dedicated professionals with diverse international backgrounds, united by a shared ambition to create progressive work with care and meaning.

 **Join our team**


Submit your portfolio and a short motivation statement on this site. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered. For any questions regarding the role, email Jesper Jonsson, Director of Experience Design, at jesper@above.se


Applications are open until 30 October 2026, and we interview shortlisted candidates on a rolling basis.


We welcome international applications and can generally help with work permits and relocation. This role isn't open to fully remote or freelance candidates, but we're happy to discuss a remote start.


Let's shape the future of design together.

title: Senior product designer
description:
**About Mimo** 




 Mimo is an AI-native platform for accounting firms. We automate the recurring work inside the monthly close, from chasing client documents and reconciling transactions to posting adjustments and reviewing VAT before it is filed, so accountants spend their time on judgement instead of admin.
 



 Accounting is being rebuilt around AI right now. We intend to be the ones who rebuild it, and to help the firms that get there first do the best work of their careers. We are a team of 35 across Stockholm and London, backed by top European investors including Northzone and Project A, growing rapidly across the UK's top 10-250 firms, with new markets next.
 



  





**The Role** 




 Accounting runs on trust and proof, every number needs an audit trail, every suggestion needs to be defensible. Combining that with AI is one of the most interesting design challenges out there right now: design is how "AI-native accounting" stops being a pitch and becomes something accountants actually trust and use every day, the moment an accountant reviews an AI-flagged anomaly, approves a suggested VAT adjustment, or chases a client for a missing invoice.
 



  





 We're now looking for a hands-on Senior Product Designer to join us. You'd join a small design team working directly with our Head of Design, with real influence over craft and process from day one, working end-to-end across our product.
 



  





**Compensation** 



* Market rate salary
* Retirement contribution
* Stock options
* Holidays: 30 days per year



  





**What you will do** 



* Design across the product, from early discovery grounded in jobs to be done, to shipped experiences that hold up on the happy path and the unhappy ones
* Work holistically across the design function, from craft to design systems to how we work together



  





**What we're looking for** 




  





**Design skills** 



* Excellent product designer (UX/UI), you've shaped products with real impact before, and can clearly point to your contribution and the decisions behind it (5+ years experience)
* Genuine curiosity about accounting and finance workflows, or excited to build that domain knowledge quickly
* Comfortable using modern AI tools to prototype and explore ideas quickly (e.g. Claude, Lovable, Figma Make)



  





**How you approach things** 



* You're a driver, not a passenger, you take initiative, lead and motivate others
* You figure out what matters most, rather than waiting for a PM or a design manager to hand you a task
* You know good ideas can come from anywhere and get them into the product fast, rather than gatekeeping
* You create momentum, remove blockers and speed up progress for yourself and others
* If the design system doesn't cover what's needed, you evolve it
* If there's friction running a research study, you figure out how to do it anyway
* Good isn't good enough, you push for great
* You know speed and quality aren't opposites, modern AI tools mean you can move fast without cutting craft



  





**Bonus** 



* Experience designing for finance, accounting, or other detail-oriented professional tools
* Familiarity with practice management or accounting software (Xero, QuickBooks, Dext, Silverfin, etc.)
* Knowledge of data-heavy interfaces, dashboards, or workflow tools

title: Experience Designer
description:
Join our multidisciplinary design team and help create exceptional product experiences for some of the world's most progressive brands. Above is now looking for talented Experience Designers for our Malmö and Stockholm studios.
   

  

**Job Description**
 The best products don't just work, they inspire. They feel intuitive and inclusive, but also surprising, delightful and a little bit magical. As an Experience Designer at Above, you'll craft meaningful experiences around interactive physical products and hardware, shaping how people see, touch, hear and feel the things they use every day.
   

  

 Our Experience Design team sits between Industrial Design, UX and Technology. We bring design and technology together from day one and prototype early and often, so physical products and the connected systems behind them feel like one seamless experience.
   

  

 You'll work in cross-functional teams with industrial and digital designers, technologists and engineers. Working closely with senior designers, you'll take ownership of defined parts of a project and grow your responsibility over time. Your work will range from designing detailed product interactions to exploring future scenarios and shaping experience visions.
   

  

**What You Will Do At Above**
* Ideate across the whole product experience, from experience visions and product archetypes to interaction paradigms and micro-interactions.
* Explore technology enablers, from what's possible today to what's coming next
* Define how a product communicates its function and behavior
* Prototype early and often, from quick form studies to low-fidelity functional models
* Communicate experiences through engaging storytelling and compelling visualizations
* Synthesize insights from user research into actionable design decisions


**What We Are Looking For**
 You might be an industrial designer with a focus on user experience, or an interaction designer with a passion for physical products. Either way, we care more about you and how you approach creative challenges than about your formal education. This role suits someone with a few years of professional experience, including recent graduates with a strong portfolio.
   

  

* A portfolio that shows bold ideas and strong conceptual thinking
* A holistic, medium-agnostic approach to design challenges, comfortable moving between digital interfaces, physical interactions, and everything in between
* A healthy obsession with aesthetics and exceptional care for details, balanced with a thorough user-centered approach
* Hands-on prototyping skills: you can quickly build low-fidelity prototypes in a range of media, such as Arduino, ProtoPie, Figma, CAD, 3D printing or video
* Curiosity about technology and how it can enable new experiences
* Comfortable working with ambiguity and unknowns, and seeing them as part of the creative process
* The ability to visualize and communicate your ideas clearly
* A humble, positive, collaborative and self-driven attitude, with a genuine desire to learn


 Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. We'd rather meet a curious, talented designer than a perfect match on paper.
   

  

**A Bit About Above**
 We are a Scandinavian innovation agency driving positive change through design, strategy and technology. Our 360° approach blurs the boundaries between hardware and software, physical and digital, strategy and execution. We work with leading global brands, ambitious startups and Scandinavian industry leaders.
   

  

 We are a team of warm, curious, and highly dedicated professionals with diverse international backgrounds, united by a shared ambition to create progressive work with care and meaning.
   

  

**Join our team**
 Submit your portfolio and a short motivation statement on this site. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered. For any questions regarding the role, email Jesper Jonsson, Director of Experience Design, at jesper@above.se
   

  

 Applications are open until 30 October 2026, and we interview shortlisted candidates on a rolling basis.
   

  

 We welcome international applications and can generally help with work permits and relocation. This role isn't open to fully remote or freelance candidates, but we're happy to discuss a remote start.
   

  

 Let's shape the future of design together.

title: Design Director
description:
Mentimeter is an engagement tool with a clear goal in mind. To make every leader better. Through real-time interactivity and clear visualizations, we get people to participate, engage and become more productive. Transforming all those passive meetings, airless classrooms and drawn out trainings into valuable insights and impactful moments.
   

  

 We truly believe that you achieve the best results by doing things together. And that successful leaders need to adopt a curious and collaborative mindset in order to get there. So with you at Mentimeter, you’ll be a big part of the ambition to help over 1 billion people listen, learn and work better together.
   

  

**The Role**
 As Design Director for our Scaling Engagement product area, you will own the experience that helps teams and whole organisations get lasting value from Mentimeter, well beyond the moment of the session itself. This is a role for a design leader who sets direction by shaping the work, not only by managing it.
   

  

 You will join a product company at a pivotal moment. Mentimeter has become very good at creating a great engagement in the moment. The hardest and most valuable design problems now sit in what comes after: turning that engagement into results people act on, insight that holds over time, and lasting value across an organisation. That is the problem this area owns, and it is one of the least solved in our space. You will operate in two primary contexts: within your Product Area Leadership, where the work happens alongside the Product Director and Engineering Director, and within the Design Leadership Team, partnering the Chief Design Officer and fellow Design leaders. You will define the experience direction for your product area and make sure design decisions translate into measurable customer and business impact.
   

  

 You will report to the Chief Design Officer.
   

  

**What We Are Looking For**
 We are looking for a design leader who leads through the work. Someone with the judgment to set a clear experience direction and the hands-on capability to raise the quality bar by shaping, critiquing, and making alongside the team.
   

  

 You have led and managed designers in fast-moving, product-led environments, and you have earned your credibility through the impact and quality of your work. You are as comfortable owning experience strategy for a product area as you are getting into the detail of a flow that isn't good enough yet. You operate as a true peer to product and engineering leaders, and you believe design is at its best when it drives outcomes, not when it decorates them.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Set the experience direction: Define a clear experience vision and architecture for your product area, and hold the quality bar that makes it real.
* Design for value that grows: Turn engagement into lasting results, insight, and adoption, designing for the team and the organisation, not only the single session.
* Turn data and insight into experience: Treat analytics, results, and recommendations as core design material, using AI to help teams and organisations see what matters and act on it.
* Drive product impact through design: Own the link between design decisions and the metrics that matter here, including retention, expansion, and how deeply and widely teams adopt Mentimeter.
* Lead as a peer in the area: Work alongside the Product Director and Engineering Director to shape area strategy and roadmap, driving user and experience thinking into the decisions that set direction.
* Own coherence across the Engagement Suite: Take responsibility for experience quality where journeys cross into adjacent areas, so scaling engagement feels like one connected experience, not a set of separate tools.
* Develop the craft and the team: Recruit, coach, and grow Product Designers primarily through the work itself, including a dotted-line group of designers in our Growth area, calibrating performance honestly and having the direct conversations that help people grow.
* Raise the bar with your peers: Work with fellow design leaders to hold shared experience principles and a shared quality standard across the craft, giving and taking critique at leadership level.
* Evolve practice through AI: Push how design understands, explores, prototypes, and delivers with AI, increasing speed and quality while protecting product thinking and craft.


**Requirements**
* 10+ years in design, including mid-to-senior management experience leading designers in fast-moving, product-led organisations.
* Proven track record of creating impactful product outcomes through design leadership and delivery.
* High personal design capability, with a portfolio that demonstrates craft judgment and range.
* A player-coach leadership style: credible with senior designers, and effective at developing them through the work.
* Track record of setting experience direction and connecting design decisions to measurable product outcomes.
* Strong business acumen and the ability to hold your own as a peer to product and engineering leadership.
* Exceptional communication skills, able to align teams and stakeholders around a clear direction.
* Practical experience applying AI to design exploration, prototyping, and delivery.


**Not Required**
 You don’t have to know Swedish. Daily work is carried out in English and the Mentimeter team currently boasts over 50 nationalities!
   

  

**Compensation**
*At Mentimeter, we believe in fair and transparent compensation that grows with you.*
*The salary range for this role is SEK88,000 - SEK102,000 per month. It’s intentionally broad to reflect the different stages of growth within the role. Where an individual is placed within the range depends on factors such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, and alignment with the role’s requirements.*
*We’re committed to supporting your growth. You’ll have ongoing development conversations with your manager and build skills, contribute to our mission and have meaningful impact.*
*In addition to your monthly salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package - learn more about it here: https://www.mentimeter.com/benefits/stockholm*
**What Mentimeter Can Offer**
 At Mentimeter we can offer a diverse and inclusive work environment supported by smart and driven colleagues. We believe in continuous professional development for all of our colleagues and therefore offer access to a leadership program (including external personal coach) and relevant education to ensure that we continue to be state-of-the-art when it comes to innovating and building Mentimeter. Your place will be in a growing company with lots of career opportunities, working on a beloved product used by more than 300 million people. It’s not all about work though, we also offer a very healthy view on work-life balance.
   

  

 All of this comes attached with a competitive compensation and benefits package, including pension contributions. Learn more about our benefits by visiting our Benefits & Perks page
   

  

**AI and Hiring at Mentimeter**
 At Mentimeter, we believe AI helps us work smarter - but it never replaces the human assessment, curiosity, and personal connection that define our culture and our hiring. We use AI as a sparring partner: to bounce ideas, bring new perspectives, support structure, and make our work more efficient. But the meaning, decisions, and interactions always come from people.
   

  

* AI does not screen or decide on candidates.
* There is no automated filtering, ranking, or decision-making in our recruitment process. Every application is reviewed by a person.
* Hiring teams may use AI to support their work - for example, to structure notes, prepare interview questions, or organize their thinking.


 AI strengthens our work, but it does not define it. At Mentimeter, we’re not building an AI-driven hiring process - we’re building a people-first culture, where technology helps us listen, learn, and grow together.
   

  

**Culture at Mentimeter**
 At Mentimeter we believe in giving everyone a voice - regardless of who you are. So we build a platform that does just that. Our platform is not only our product but also our organization. A platform where people feel safe, where differences are embraced, a place where you can have fun. We strongly encourage applicants who are people of color, LGBTQ+, women, people with disabilities, and/or formerly incarcerated people, and a college degree is not strictly required. In order to give everyone a voice, we need to be as diverse as our users.
   

  

 Learn more about our culture by visiting our Culture page.
   

  

 Review our Privacy Policy for more information.

title: Design Engineer - EU
description:
Hi 👋🏾 I’m Abhik, Ashby's Co-Founder and VP of Engineering. This role is close to my heart because, as someone who can both design and code, it’s where I’ve always done my best work, but also where I was seen as a rebel and an outsider. I want folks like me to feel at home at Ashby, and so I made Design Engineering a formal role and department that works closely with me. Our first hire was over five years ago, and we’re doubling the team from five to over ten in the next year.
   

  

 This role truly expects you to design and code. Design Engineer at Ashby isn’t just a Frontend Engineer with new branding, nor is it a Designer vibe coding prototypes. Combining excellence in both is where magic happens. I found that when I put my best effort into both the design and technical implementation of a feature, I had a nimbleness and creativity that was hard to achieve when I did only one or the other. For instance, the UX and UI I envisioned often influenced the data model's design and flexibility, while the understanding of technology's capabilities often simplified or improved the design. This role embraces that.
   

  

 You’ll Work On Our Most Challenging Design Problems, Help Others Improve Their Designs By Expanding And Enhancing Our In-house Design System, And Consult On Bespoke Design Work Needed By Product Engineers. To Ground It With Examples, Design Engineers At Ashby Have:
   

  

* Redesigned our mobile web app by talking with customers who use it often, wireframing new flows, implementing its design system, and using that system to turn the wireframes into a polished UI.
* Built a set of flexible, composable components in our design system that allow other engineers to build beautiful, consistent setup wizards across our product easily.
* Helped a Product Engineer improve the information hierarchy and scannability of their design for viewing a candidate’s assessments. Recruiters can quickly parse information and pick out anomalies.


 The Design Engineer Role Is More Common Today Than Five Years Ago, But I Believe Ashby Offers a Unique Opportunity That Few Can Match:
   

  

* You work on a product at scale, not at an early-stage startup struggling to find users and get feedback on what you’ve designed and built. At Ashby, your work will touch over 100,000 weekly active users, millions of candidates per week, and notable customers like Notion, Linear, Shopify, and Snowflake. You’ll get to test out ideas with our own recruiting team and hiring managers who use Ashby every day (like me), and often hear customer feedback as early as the day you release.
* This role has always had the commitment of both Benji (CEO & Co-Founder) and me: I’ve held the role, steadfastly championed it since we started hiring in 2020, and haven’t diluted its responsibilities as we’ve grown (in fact, we’ve doubled down).
* You get to shape the UI and UX of a powerful and complex product. Our users need software that helps them move quickly while adapting to their unique workflows and preferences. As a result, our UI isn’t a simple chatbox, but it can’t rely on a sea of knobs and dials either. It needs to feel approachable to someone using it for the first time while offering increasingly powerful ways to customize and automate their work.


**Why You Shouldn’t Apply**
 Design Engineers Come In Many Flavors, Not All Of Which Fit Our Model. Here Are Some Reasons You Might Not Enjoy The Role:
   

  

* You only want to work on design systems. While improving our design system is one of many responsibilities, you won’t be able to work on it exclusively.
* You like to do extensive research and user testing before implementation. The beauty of being part-Engineer is that you can build conviction by shipping to a subset of users (including our own team) and gathering feedback!
* You want everything to be perfect before it gets into a user’s hands. One of the drivers of our success is that we ship fast. While we appreciate the strive for perfection, we also realize it doesn’t need to be achieved all at once; instead, we iterate over time, often letting user feedback and business needs drive prioritization.
* You don’t have excellent taste and execution in visual design. Design Engineers set the bar for visual design in our app and continually improve it, pushing its boundaries with each new feature or redesign.
* You need company-driven process and structure to get your projects across the finish line. Sprint planning and well-defined project management processes are things you need or look to others to lead. You’d rather focus on the design and technical details.
* You only want to do exciting work. We’re building a team of kind, collaborative folks. Customer issues and investigations are distributed across the team, including our high-level ICs.


****What Seniority/Level To Apply For****
 We’ve posted levels from Junior to Staff. The higher the level, the more experience and alignment with the role we expect when reviewing your application and while interviewing.
 *Please apply to the one that sets the right expectations.*
* Junior Design Engineer - You should have no more than 2 years of industry experience as a designer or engineer. We want to see projects (personal or professional) with at least a couple of users that showcase great visual taste and burgeoning talent in both UI/UX and Engineering.
* Design Engineer (This Posting) - This posting covers both Mid and Senior levels. You have 2+ years of continuous experience (e.g., internships don’t count) as an Engineer or a Designer. You have good proficiency in both Design and Engineering, with exceptional proficiency in the discipline you practice full-time. Regardless of which discipline you’re coming from, we expect experience designing products and shipping code to hundreds of users (even if through side projects).
* Staff Design Engineer - We’re looking for folks who’ve practiced our flavor of Design Engineering professionally. It may not be through a formal title, but you’ve made major contributions to a design system and designed and implemented features for hundreds of users and iterated on them through user feedback.


 Internally, we do not use these titles, but Engineers are leveled based on proficiency (which you can read about here).
   

  

 What We’re Building
   

  

 As engineers, we are used to tooling that makes us
 **better** 
 at what we do. When we started Ashby, we saw the opposite with Talent Acquisition software. Recruiting teams were leveling up how they did their work, but instead of software meeting this new standard, it held them back.
   

  

 Scheduling a final round is an excellent example. Recruiting teams wanted to schedule candidates faster, track interviewer preparation and quality, and do it with half the headcount. A recruiter needed to manually collect availability from the candidate, identify qualified interviewers, perform “Calendar Tetris” to find who is available to interview the candidate, schedule on the earliest date possible, and make any last-minute adjustments as availability changed. They must do this while considering the interview load on each individual and whether interviewers need to be trained and shadowing others. 🥵 TA software didn’t help.
   

  

 As hiring managers, we know TA is a critical function, and as engineers, we know software can do better. So, we built and continue to build Ashby to give TA teams the
 *highest* 
 standard of tooling. Software that’s intelligent and powerful. Software that provides insights into where they’re failing and automates or simplifies many of the tasks they’re underwater with. We want other functions and departments to be jealous of what TA teams can do with Ashby, and today they often are!
   

  

 As we’ve set the standard for excellence in TA software, HR teams have pulled us into solving their problems in areas like onboarding and performance management.
   

  

 Engineering Culture
   

  

 Our Engineering Culture Is Motivated By Benji’s (my Co-founder And CEO) And My Belief That a Small, Talented Team, Given The Right Environment, Can Build High-quality Software Fast (and Work Regular Hours!). We Do It Through:
   

  

* Minimal process with ownership over decisions normally made by product and design
* Natural collaboration and deliberate communication
* Investing in tools and abstractions that give us leverage
* Putting effort into building a diverse team


**Minimal Process & Lots of Ownership**
 The best engineers we’ve worked with delivered reliably magical outcomes. They took customer problems and relentlessly drove them to solutions that were not only successful but often brilliant and creative. While they did this with minimal oversight, stakeholders were never in the dark as to what was going on, and no setback was a surprise.
   

  

 Traditional product-development processes aren’t meant for the best engineers. Their purpose is to create consistent outcomes regardless of the engineer’s skill. But, consistency comes at the expense of an engineer’s time and freedom—both ingredients necessary to generate those magical outcomes. As a result, process stifles the best engineers and doesn’t give others the opportunity to practice the behaviors that made the best engineers the “best.”
   

  

 At Ashby, we want to build an environment that encourages every engineer to be their best. So, at Ashby, every Engineer runs their project. Product Managers (and Designers) build strategy, do customer research, and hand off problem briefs to Engineers. Engineers take on the rest: they research the problem, write product specs, build wireframes, and implement their solution end-to-end. We rely on engineers, not process, to push information outward to the relevant folks (e.g., Product Managers) and pull folks in to help (e.g., Designers, Infra). It’s a new level of ownership for many engineers, but we’d rather an engineer fail a bit and coach up their skills than use process as a crutch. Not everyone succeeds in our culture, but those who do
 *thrive* 
 .
   

  

**Collaboration is Natural & Communication is Deliberate**
 Our engineering team consists of lifelong learners who are talented but also humble and kind (meet them here!). These attributes create an environment where collaboration happens naturally. We combine this with research, prototyping, and written proposals to see around corners and get feedback from the team across time zones. Focus time is something that we hold sacred, and, with thoughtful and deliberate communication, engineers are in <2h meetings per week (I wrote about it here).
   

  

 Today, 25% of engineers and 50% of our engineering leaders at Ashby are from underrepresented groups. We are taking conscious steps to improve, like sourcing diverse candidates, providing generous paid family leave, no leetcode interviews, and more.
   

  

 We also meet in person at least twice a year, once as a department and once as a company. You also have a small budget to meet up with folks in your city/region.
   

  

**Increase Leverage, not Team Size**
 We Built Ashby With The Quality, Breadth, And Depth That Many Customers Would Expect From Much Larger Teams Over Larger Time Scales. We’ve Done This Through Investment In:
   

  

* Great developer tooling. Our CI/CD takes ~10m, and we deploy at least 15x a day. A debugger that works out of the box. Everyone on the team has contributed to our developer experience 💪🏾.
* Building blocks to create powerful and customizable products fast. At the core of Ashby is a set of common components (analytics modeling and query language, policy engine, workflow engine, design system) that we constantly improve. Each improvement to a common component cascades throughout our app (short video below).
* AI-powered tooling. We think of AI as a way to automate the mundane parts of building and maintaining high-quality software. We use a combination of third-party and internally built tools that, for instance, auto-triage customer issues, suggest fixes, prototype ideas, generate production-ready code, and conduct code reviews. Engineers have an unlimited token budget (but are not measured on it). We write in detail about our philosophy, current use of AI, and future plans for AI in Engineering here.


**And a Demo Of One Of These Building Blocks:**
 Here’s an impromptu quote from Arjun in our company Slack of what it’s like to build a feature at Ashby:
   

  

**Put Effort into Diversity**
 Diverse teams drive innovation and better outcomes. Having seen my mother and partner build their careers as minority women in non-diverse fields, I want to make sure Ashby creates opportunities for the next generation of engineers from underrepresented groups.
   

  

 Today, 25% of engineers and 50% of our engineering leaders at Ashby are from underrepresented groups. We are taking conscious steps to improve, like sourcing diverse candidates, providing generous paid family leave, no leetcode interviews, and more.
   

  

**Work-Life Balance: It’s A Marathon, Not a Sprint**
 The intensity of work at Ashby should feel like a marathon, not a sprint (nor speed-walking). We work with urgency and ambition to build excellent software, but we don’t need to prove out a new software category or product-market fit. That requires ingenuity and thoughtfulness, and that doesn’t happen with unrealistic deadlines or sleepless nights.
   

  

 Our remote, low-meeting, high-ownership culture gives you
 *a lot* 
 of flexibility in how you structure your days and weeks. In practice, that means you keep your own hours, but there will be moments of intensity, like launching your feature at our annual user conference. We offer unlimited PTO, and you actually get to use it. Some of our most exceptional engineers take almost 30 days of vacation per year.
   

  

 This way of working allows many of us on the team to be active parents, including Benji and me. I block off 1.5 hours every morning to spend with my daughter and drop her off at school. Mujda (Product Engineer) puts it best in an article about us: “I can say that Ashby is a great place to be a mom… No one bats an eye if I have to take my kid to a doctor’s appointment or have to work weird hours because childcare fell through.”
   

  

**Interview Process**
 At Ashby, our team and interview process want to help you show your best self. We’ll dive into past projects and simulate working together through pair programming, designing, writing design system specs collaboratively, and discussing decisions. There are no leetcode or whiteboard exercises.
   

  

**Our Interview Process Is Three Rounds:**
* Introduction call with me (30m, live). Be prepared to screen-share examples of your work.
* A second round where we either do a technical screen (1h, live) or a design take-home (~3h async, 30m live)
* Three interviews, a deep dive into a past design system or design project, a design system interview, and the interview we didn’t do in the second round: technical screen or design take-home. (3h, live)


 Depending on our leadership team’s bandwidth, we may start with an additional 30m screen with a recruiter.
   

  

 I will be your main point of contact and prep you for interviews. Each round will have written guidance so you know what to expect. You’ll meet 3-4 people in Design Engineering (with 5-15 minutes in each interview to ask them questions). If we don’t give an offer, we’ll provide feedback!
   

  

**Your First Three Months at Ashby**
 We want an exceptional onboarding experience for every new hire. At Ashby, your dev environment is set up with a single script, you push your first product change on day one, and you spend the rest of your time shipping product changes that give you a tour of our codebase and best practices. The product changes increase in scope and ambiguity from simple copy changes to the delivery of a prominent, impactful feature. Your manager will do a 30, 60, and 90-day review to give feedback and calibrate on how we work together.
   

  

 It’s a team effort to get you successfully onboarded; you’ll have a peer paired with you to answer questions, pair program, and check in often to see if you need help. The rest of the team will run training sessions on our culture, product, engineering process, and technical architecture.
   

  

**Technology Stack**
 Our tech stack is TypeScript (frontend & backend), React, GraphQL API, Node.js, Postgres, and Redis. Depending on the level you’re applying for and your past experience, we expect, at a minimum, good proficiency with TypeScript, React, and CSS. Proficiency with backend technologies is a plus, as it allows you to work without coordinating with Product Engineers.
   

  

****Benefits****
* Competitive salary and equity.
* 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.
* Unlimited PTO, and we will encourage you to take it.
* A minimum of 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave, covered by Ashby. For folks outside the US, it may be longer to be in line with regional requirements.
* Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!
* $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.
* $250/month tool budget plus access to Claude, Cursor, and Codex with generous token budgets.
* If you’re in the US, we offer top-tier health insurance for you and your dependents, with 100% of premiums covered by Ashby. In other countries, we provide high-quality supplemental health insurance for you and your dependents, also fully covered by us.


 Ashby’s success hinges on hiring great people and creating an environment where we can be happy, feel challenged, and do our best work. We’re being deliberate about building that environment from the ground up. I hope that excites you enough to apply.
   

  

*Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.*
*Ashby is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing vacancy within our organization. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position.*
 Compensation Range: €60K - €145K

title: Service Designer
description:
**Company**
 team.blue is an ecosystem of 60+ successful PaaS and SaaS brands working together across 22 European countries to provide its 3.5 million SMB customers with everything they need to succeed online by offering best-in-class expertise and services.
   

  

 team.blue's brands are a mix of traditional hosting businesses that offer services from domain names, email, shared hosting, e-commerce, and server hosting solutions and, as specialist SaaS providers, adjacent products such as compliance, marketing tools, and team collaboration products. This broad product offering makes it a one-stop partner for online businesses and entrepreneurs across Europe.
   

  

**Position**
 We are looking for a Service Designer to help design and transform the customer care services that underpin our AI-powered customer experience across brands.
   

  

 You will analyse how customer journeys, processes and support services work today, identify opportunities for improvement, and design scalable future-state services that work for both customers and customer care teams. You will work closely with local brands and stakeholders to understand how things work in practice, challenge existing processes and translate them into clear, effective service designs that can be supported by AI.
   

  

 This is a hands-on design role: we are looking for someone who can deep-dive into existing services, identify what needs to change, and create the blueprint for how the future service should work.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Service & Process Design
   

  

* Analyse existing customer journeys, processes and service flows across brands and identify opportunities for improvement
* Challenge existing processes and uncover gaps, inconsistencies and unnecessary complexity from a customer and operational perspective
* Design and document future-state customer journeys, service flows and processes that support AI-powered customer care
* Identify where processes should be redesigned, simplified or standardised to enable scalable AI-supported services
* Translate complex business and customer needs into clear, practical service designs and blueprints
* Consider the operational implications of new service designs, including how services will be supported and maintained after launch


 Discovery & Stakeholder Collaboration
   

  

* Work closely with local brands and customer care teams to understand how services operate in practice
* Ask the right questions, challenge assumptions and extract the information needed to understand current processes and customer needs
* Facilitate discussions and workshops with business and operational stakeholders to develop and validate service designs
* Balance customer needs, operational requirements and technical possibilities when designing solutions
* Build alignment around future-state processes and ways of working across different brands


 AI Customer Care & Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Translate existing customer journeys and service processes into designs that can be supported by AI
* Identify where AI can improve, automate or augment customer interactions and where human intervention remains necessary
* Support the transition from current-state processes to future-state AI-enabled customer care
* Validate designs with relevant stakeholders and incorporate feedback and learnings into the service blueprint
* Contribute to the development of a scalable approach that can be applied across multiple brands


**Requirements**
* 5+ years of experience in Service Design, Customer Experience, Process Design, Service Management or a related field, ideally in a larger or complex organisation
* Proven experience personally owning and delivering customer-facing service, process or journey design and redesign
* Strong ability to analyse existing processes and customer journeys, identify opportunities and design scalable future-state solutions
* Strong customer-first mindset, with the ability to balance customer needs with business and operational requirements

title: Digital Experience Specialist
description:
**Vill du vara med och skapa en sammanhållen, relevant och användarvänlig digital upplevelse för Rexels kunder?**
 Vill du utveckla vår digitala närvaro och göra det enklare för kunderna att hitta rätt? Känner du dig hemma kring digitalt innehåll, struktur och användarvänliga kundupplevelser? Trivs du i en operativ roll där du får arbeta hands-on med webb, nyhetsbrev och löpande förbättringar? Då kan rollen som Digital Experience Specialist hos Rexel vara rätt för dig.
   

  

**Om rollen**
 Som Digital Experience Specialist är du operativ helhetsägare för innehållet på Rexels webbplats och en sammanhållande länk mellan e-handel, marknad och kommunikation. Du säkerställer att innehåll tas emot, webbanpassas, struktureras, publiceras, kvalitetssäkras och hålls aktuellt utifrån marknadsplanens prioriteringar och tidsplan.
   

  

 Du ansvarar också för att planera, sätta upp, kvalitetssäkra, schemalägga och skicka nyhetsbrev till olika kundsegment. Grundinnehåll och budskap tas fram av marknad och kommunikation, vid behov med stöd av externa byråer. Din uppgift är att göra materialet relevant, tydligt och användarvänligt i rätt digital kanal.
   

  

 Utifrån analys, kundinsikter och användarfeedback drar du slutsatser och genomför konkreta förbättringar i innehåll, struktur och digital kommunikation. Rollen rapporterar till e-handelschef och arbetar nära marknad och kommunikation för att skapa en sammanhållen digital upplevelse som stödjer affärsmål, varumärke och kundbehov.
   

  

**Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter**
* 
+ Ansvara för publicering, innehållsförvaltning och optimering av företagets webbplats och digitala kanaler.
+ Planera och genomföra segmenterad kundkommunikation och nyhetsbrev i Microsoft Dynamics Customer Insights Journeys.
+ Säkerställa en attraktiv och användarvänlig digital kundupplevelse genom analys, förbättringsarbete och löpande optimering.
+ Kvalitetssäkra innehåll utifrån varumärkesriktlinjer, tonalitet, SEO och bästa praxis för webb.
+ Samordna innehållsleveranser och publiceringar tillsammans med e-handel, marknad, kommunikation och externa partners.
+ Bidra till utvecklingen av digitala arbetssätt, kundresor och webbplatsens funktionalitet genom att identifiera och driva förbättringar.


**Vem är du?**
 För att trivas i rollen är du en självgående och initiativrik person som driver ditt arbete framåt med struktur, noggrannhet och hög kvalitet. Du har ett öga för digitalt innehåll och visuellt uttryck, samtidigt som du är kreativ, kundorienterad och nyfiken på hur kommunikation och digitala flöden kan utvecklas och förbättras.
   

  

 Du tycker om att samarbeta med olika delar av verksamheten och är en prestigelös lagspelare som trivs i en praktisk, operativ roll där du får möjlighet att utvecklas.
   

  

 Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av operativt webbarbete, CMS-publicering och produktion av nyhetsbrev. Du har god känsla för digital kommunikation och erfarenhet av enklare bild- och textredigering. Du är van att använda data, analys och användarinsikter för att förbättra innehåll och publicering.
   

  

 Du har grundläggande kunskaper inom SEO, digitala kundresor, UX och konvertering samt förståelse för hur digitalt innehåll bidrar till exempelvis information, varumärkesbyggande, engagemang och försäljning.
   

  

 Du uttrycker dig väl på svenska och engelska i tal och skrift. Har du erfarenhet av Smart Edit, Amplience eller Microsoft Dynamics är det meriterande, liksom erfarenhet från B2B-kommunikation eller B2B-e-handel.
   

  

**Varför Rexel?**
 Hos oss får du en praktisk och utvecklande roll med stor möjlighet att påverka hur Rexel möter kunderna digitalt. Du blir en viktig del av e-handelsteamet och arbetar nära marknad och kommunikation i ett uppdrag där struktur, samarbete och kontinuerliga förbättringar står i centrum.
   

  

 Rexel är en världsomspännande elgrossist och distributör inom elteknik med stor närvaro i Sverige. Här blir du del av ett bolag som på riktigt bidrar till omställningen mot ett mer hållbart samhälle. Vi jobbar aktivt för en inkluderande kultur där olika bakgrund, erfarenhet och perspektiv ses som en styrka. Hos oss är det viktigt att du kan vara dig själv.
   

  

* Vi tar hand om dig! Vi erbjuder en tillsvidareanställning med provanställning, konkurrenskraftiga förmåner och bra arbetsvillkor med kollektivavtal. Du arbetar endast på vardagar och får tjänstepension, föräldralön, extra ersättning vid sjukdom, friskvårdsbidrag och förkortad veckoarbetstid under sommaren.
* The Rexel way! Vårt sätt att arbeta och vara tillsammans – vår kultur – kallar vi för The Rexel way. Det innebär att vi alltid strävar efter att skapa bästa kundupplevelsen, samarbetar för framgång och uppmuntrar innovation. Vi stöttar varandras utveckling, litar på varandra och gör skillnad- tillsammans.
* Utveckling! Utveckling är nödvändigt i vår bransch och något vi brinner för. Genom vår utbildningsplattform SkillUp ges alla möjlighet till kontinuerlig kompetensutveckling inom både hardskills och softskills; försäljning, produkt, förnybar energi, ledarskap eller effektivisera med AI.
* Kom som du är! Vi arbetar för att skapa en arbetsplats där alla känner sig välkomna och uppskattade. Din unika bakgrund och perspektiv är värdefulla för oss!


**Ansökan**
 Låter det här som något för dig isåfall är du varmt välkommen med din ansökan. Intervjuer sker löpande vilket innebär att tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum. Vill du veta mer om jobbet eller Rexel är du välkommen att kontakta rekryterande chef Jessica Kettunen på 072-208 81 36 eller via mail till jessica.kettunen@rexel.se.
   

  

 Vi ser fram emot din ansökan.
   

  

**Om Rexel**
 Rexel är en av världens största energiteknikleverantörer med verksamhet i 17 länder. Vi tror på att bidra med vår positiva energi i allt vi gör och varje dag guidar vi våra kunder genom utmaningarna i deras arbete för att göra installationer, infrastrukturer och fastigheter mer bekväma, säkra och energieffektiva. Vi kopplar samman och distribuerar morgondagens hållbara elektriska värld. Idag. Läs mer om Rexel på rexel.se och hur det är att jobba hos oss här: https://careers.rexel.com/
   

  

 Rexel. Electrifying solutions that make a sustainable future possible.
   

  

*Inför rekryteringsarbetet har Rexel Sverige AB noggrant tagit ställning till rekryteringskanaler och marknadsföring. Vi undanber oss därför bestämt kontakt med mediesäljare, rekryteringssajter och liknande.*

title: Examensarbete: Digitalt verktyg för kvalitetssäkrad produktintroduktion
description:
30 hp Examensarbete: Digitalt verktyg för kvalitetssäkrad produktintroduktion
   

  

 Bakgrund
   

  

 Vid produktintroduktioner behöver flera organisationer bidra med information, bedömningar och beslut. Underlaget behöver vara komplett, entydigt och uppdaterat för att rätt aktiviteter ska kunna planeras och genomföras i rätt tid.
   

  

 I dag kan processen innebära många manuella överlämningar, olika arbetssätt och information i flera system eller dokument. Det ökar risken för att krav och förutsättningar tolkas olika, att ändringar inte slår igenom överallt eller att viktiga kontrollpunkter missas. Det finns därför ett behov av ett digitalt verktyg som gör processen enklare att följa, kvalitetssäkra och styra, samtidigt som det tydliggör ansvar, status och kvarstående avvikelser.
   

  

 Mål
   

  

 Målet är att ta fram och utvärdera ett digitalt verktyg eller en prototyp som kvalitetssäkrar och förenklar processen för produktintroduktioner. Verktyget ska stödja strukturerad insamling och granskning av input från flera organisationer, skapa spårbarhet i ändringar och beslut samt ge en tydlig bild av processens status och eventuella brister.
   

  

 Uppdragsbeskrivning
   

  

 Arbetet kan exempelvis omfatta följande delar:
   

  

 Kartläggning av nuläge - Beskriv dagens process för produktintroduktioner, berörda organisationer, informationsflöden, kontrollpunkter och vanliga problemområden.
   

  

 Kravställning - Identifiera användarbehov och formulera krav på information,kvalitetssäkring, spårbarhet och uppföljning.
   

  

 Process- och informationsmodell - Utforma ett förslag på hur produktintroduktionen kan struktureras digitalt, inklusive centrala objekt, relationer, ansvar och beslutspunkter.
   

  

 Utveckling av verktyg eller prototyp - Implementera en avgränsad, användbar lösning som demonstrerar de viktigaste funktionerna och arbetsflödena.
   

  

 Verifiering och utvärdering - Testa lösningen med relevanta användare och ett eller flera representativa produktintroduktionsfall. Bedöm användbarhet, datakvalitet, spårbarhet och förmåga att upptäcka saknad eller motstridig information.
   

  

 Utbildning/linje/inriktning
   

  

 Civilingenjör eller högskoleingenjör inom industriell ekonomi, logistik, produktionsteknik, systemvetenskap, datavetenskap, informationssystem eller motsvarande. Intresse för verksamhetsutveckling, digitalisering och användarcentrerad systemutveckling är meriterande.
   

  

 Antal studerande
   

  

 1-2 personer
   

  

 Startdatum för ex-jobbet
   

  

 Januari 2027 (förslag, kan anpassas efter överenskommelse)
   

  

 Beräknad tidsåtgång
   

  

 6 månader
   

  

 Kontaktpersoner och handledare
   

  

 Mattias Eriksson, Gruppchef Logistikutveckling, mattias.eriksson@scania.com
   

  

 Dhinesh Kumar Muruganandam, Gruppchef Logistikutveckling, dhinesh.kumar.muruganandam@scania.com
   

  

 Ansökan
   

  

 Din ansökan ska innehålla CV, personligt brev och betygsutdrag. Beskriv gärna relevanta projekt eller kurser inom processutveckling, informationsmodellering, programmering, kravställning eller digitala verktyg.
   

  

 En bakgrundskontroll kan göras för denna position. Vi genomför intervjuer löpande och kan komma att avsluta rekryteringen tidigare än angivet.

title: Brand Designer
description:
SCRL is one of Sweden's most successful tech companies you've probably never heard of.
   

  

 We build creative tools used by 7 million monthly active creators around the world. By combining design, technology and a deep understanding of how people create content, we're shaping the future of social media design.
   

  

 We've done it without raising venture capital or chasing headlines. Instead, we've focused on creating products people genuinely love and building a company with ambitious, thoughtful people who care deeply about their craft.
   

  

**The role**
 As a Brand Designer, you’ll help build SCRL’s visual identity and turn it into a distinctive, recognizable brand across every touchpoint.
   

  

 You’ll work across brand, website, campaigns, social, marketing, app launches and other creative initiatives. You’ll collaborate closely with the design leadership and other teams across SCRL to make sure everything we put into the world feels connected and intentional.
   

  

 This is a hands-on role. We’re looking for someone who can think big and conceptually, but who also enjoys opening Figma and making the work themselves. Someone who cares about the idea, but cares just as much about how it’s executed.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Evolve and strengthen SCRL’s visual identity and design language
* Develop creative concepts and campaigns that make SCRL stand out
* Design assets for web, social, app stores, launches and marketing
* Create visual systems, templates and guidelines that help the wider team work consistently
* Explore new visual directions and bring fresh ideas to the brand
* Help define and raise the creative quality bar across SCRL
* Contribute to the broader creative vision and visual culture of the team


**What We’re Looking For**
* 6+ years of experience in brand, visual or digital design
* A strong portfolio with distinctive, thoughtful and highly crafted work
* Excellent understanding of typography, composition, color and art direction
* Strong conceptual thinking and the ability to turn an idea into compelling visual work
* Experience designing for digital and social-first environments
* Strong attention to detail and a high bar for craft
* Comfortable moving between strategy, concepts and hands-on production
* Comfortable working in a fast-moving, collaborative environment
* Experience with Framer is a plus (website)
* Experience with motion is a plus


**The kind of person you are**
 You’re curious, visually driven and always looking for ways to make things better.
   

  

 You have strong taste and a clear point of view, but you’re not precious about your ideas. You can explain why something works, take feedback and quickly make it better.
   

  

 You care about the details, but you also know when to move fast. You’re comfortable figuring things out as you go and don’t need everything to be perfectly defined before you start.
   

  

**Most importantly, you want to build a brand, not just produce assets.**
**Why SCRL**
 This is a Stockholm-based role and we work together from our office near Slussen. We're builders at heart and believe great companies are created when talented people spend time together, challenge each other and move quickly towards ambitious goals.
   

  

 If you thrive in high-trust environments, enjoy a high bar for quality and want to help shape the next chapter of a profitable, product-led company, we'd love to hear from you.
   

  

 We’re a growing team based in central Stockholm, working closely across disciplines to build products people love. We care deeply about craft, collaboration and creating a place where everyone can learn and grow.

title: Senior Product Manager - Search & AI Discovery (12 months parental cover)
description:
**Job Description**

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**
  

 As Senior Product Manager for
 **Search & AI Discovery** 
 , you will shape how customers find, explore and connect with our digital commerce experience — across traditional search and the next generation of AI-powered discovery. You will lead a cross-functional team focused on building strong technical foundations for discoverability while preparing the business for emerging search experiences, shopping agents and agentic commerce.
   

  





**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**
  

 You will collaborate closely with developers, an Engineering Manager, an Analyst and, when needed, a Solution Architect. Together, you will work at the intersection of
 **technical SEO** 
 , digital commerce and emerging
 **AI-led discovery** 
 , partnering across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Content, Analytics and Commercial teams.
   

  





 You will own the product strategy and roadmap for search discoverability, ensuring our digital platforms are built to be visible, scalable and high-performing across markets. This includes core technical SEO capabilities such as metadata, canonicals, XML sitemaps, robots.txt, structured data, hreflang, URL structures, pagination, faceted navigation and Core Web Vitals.
   

  





 Beyond today’s search landscape, you will help define how we show up in AI-powered search, generative discovery and shopping-agent experiences. You will monitor developments from key platforms and partners, translate external change into clear recommendations, and turn emerging opportunities into experiments, product priorities and business impact.
   

  





 As the digital lead for agentic commerce, you will drive alignment, clarity and adoption across teams. You will make complex SEO and AI-search topics understandable for different audiences, from engineers and specialists to business stakeholders and senior leaders, while balancing long-term direction with practical delivery, experimentation and continuous improvement.
   

  





**Key Responsibilities**



* Define and evolve the product strategy and roadmap for Search & AI Discovery.
* Lead the technical SEO roadmap across scalable digital commerce platforms.
* Improve discoverability, site performance and search-readiness across markets and customer journeys.
* Explore and shape opportunities within AI search, generative discovery and agentic commerce.
* Turn developments from Google, OpenAI and other relevant platforms into product recommendations, tests and priorities.
* Embed SEO and AI discovery considerations into relevant digital initiatives and ways of working.
* Lead and support audits, pilots, experiments and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Partner with engineering teams to translate discovery needs into clear requirements and backlog priorities.
* Collaborate with Marketing, Content, Analytics and Commercial teams to strengthen content readiness and customer discoverability.
* Communicate technical and strategic topics with clarity to product, business and senior leadership audiences.



**WHO YOU ARE**
  

 To thrive in this role, we believe you have:
   

  




* Experience in product management, digital commerce, SEO, search or related digital product areas.
* A solid understanding of technical SEO and its role in e-commerce growth, performance and discoverability.
* Good understanding of web technologies, CMS platforms and front-end fundamentals, including HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
* Experience working closely with engineering teams in an agile product development setup.
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to use data to identify opportunities, shape priorities and evaluate impact.
* The ability to translate complex technical topics into clear recommendations and actionable product priorities.
* Strong communication, collaboration and stakeholder management skills.
* You are curious about the future of digital discovery and motivated by turning change into opportunity.
* Excellent communication skills in English.



**This role is 12 months parental cover and position is based in Stockholm, Sweden.** 
 We are unable to provide relocation assistance or visa sponsorship for this position. Applicants must already have the right to work in Sweden.
   

  

  

  




**Additional Information**

**WHO WE ARE** 
**​**
  

 H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.​
   

  





 We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. ​
   

  





**WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE** 
**​** 
  

  

 At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. ​
   

  




* 25% Staff discount on all our H&M Group brands, both in stores and online (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories and ARKET).
* H&M Incentive Program – HIP. Learn more about the program here.
* In addition to our global benefits, our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. (Example: Competitive compensation for your dedication and long-term commitment. A day off on your birthday to relax and celebrate your special day. Special gift to celebrate the birth of your child, etc.)



**JOIN US** 
**​**
  

 Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.​
   

  





 Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.​

title: IT-specialist sökes till STFs huvudkontor
description:
Svenska Turistföreningen är en ideell förening med cirka 195 000 medlemmar. Vi arbetar ständigt för att göra hela Sverige tillgängligt och verkar för att fler ska få möjlighet att uppleva svensk natur och kultur, både som medlem och gäst hos något av våra boenden.

##### **Vill du använda din tekniska kompetens i en organisation som gör det möjligt för fler att upptäcka Sverige?**

  

Svenska Turistföreningen, STF, fortsätter att utveckla sin IT-miljö för att skapa en säker, stabil och modern grund för framtidens digitala lösningar. Nu söker de en erfaren IT-specialist som vill ta ett brett ansvar för deras IT-infrastruktur - med särskilt fokus på Microsoft 365, Microsoft Defender, identitet, säkerhet och nätverk.


Här får du arbeta både operativt och utvecklingsinriktat i en liten IT-organisation med korta beslutsvägar. Du blir en viktig teknisk kompetens internt och får samtidigt möjlighet att påverka hur STF arbetar med IT och säkerhet framåt.

###### **Om rollen**


Som IT-specialist blir du en del av avdelningen IT & Digitalisering, som består av sju medarbetare samt ett antal konsulter. Avdelningen ansvarar för STFs tekniska IT-infrastruktur, systemförvaltning, utveckling och övriga digitalisering.


STF har en geografiskt spridd och varierad verksamhet med kontor, fjällstationer och andra boendeanläggningar runt om i Sverige. Det skapar en spännande teknisk miljö där du behöver kunna se helheten, lösa konkreta problem och anpassa lösningar efter olika delar av verksamheten. Du kommer både att arbeta hands-on i den tekniska miljön och samordna, prioritera och ställa krav på externa IT-leverantörer.

**Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter:**

* Stödja, driva och vidareutveckla lösningar inom Microsoft 365, med särskilt fokus på säkerhet och nätverk
* Vidareutveckla säkerhetsrelaterade processer och omsätta verksamhetens behov i tekniska lösningar
* Arbeta operativt med Microsoft Defender och andra säkerhetslösningar
* Administrera och utveckla lösningar inom Active Directory och Microsoft Entra ID
* Hantera incidenter kopplade till drift, backup och IT-säkerhet
* Prioritera och hantera ärenden i samarbete med externa leverantörer
* Bidra i arbetet med IT-infrastrukturen på STFs anläggningar


Rollen är bred och vardagen kan variera. Du behöver därför trivas med att ta dig an både planerade utvecklingsinitiativ och mer akuta operativa frågor. Resor till STFs fjällstationer och andra anläggningar kan förekomma.

**Är det här du?**


Vi söker dig som har bred erfarenhet av IT-drift och IT-infrastruktur, kombinerat med djup kompetens inom Microsofts plattformar och säkerhetslösningar. Du har arbetat praktiskt med tekniken och känner dig trygg i att själv kunna analysera problem, hantera incidenter och föreslå relevanta lösningar.


Samtidigt kan du lyfta blicken och fungera som en tydlig beställare gentemot externa leverantörer. Du kan översätta verksamhetens behov till tekniska krav, prioritera insatser och följa upp att leveranser håller rätt kvalitet.

 **Du behöver ha:**

* Senior och operativ erfarenhet av Microsoft Defender samt arbete med IT-säkerhet och incidenthantering
* Djup kunskap om Microsoft 365-plattformen, inklusive Intune, Teams, SharePoint och Exchange Online
* Avancerad kunskap om identitets- och åtkomsthantering i Active Directory och Microsoft Entra ID, inklusive Microsoft Entra Connect, MFA och Conditional Access, samt erfarenhet av PowerShell
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta operativt med drift, administration, felsökning och incidenthantering i Microsoftmiljöer
* Erfarenhet av att vara beställare och kravställare gentemot externa IT-leverantörer
* God förståelse för IT-infrastruktur, nätverk och Windows Server
* God förmåga att uttrycka dig på svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.

**Det är meriterande om du även har:**

* Erfarenhet av andra MDM-lösningar utöver Intune
* Relevanta Microsoftcertifieringar
* Högskoleutbildning inom IT, systemvetenskap eller motsvarande.

**Dina personliga egenskaper**


Vi värdesätter dina personliga egenskaper högt. Du är strukturerad och självgående med förmåga att se helheten. Du har god problemlösningsförmåga och trivs i en roll där du får arbeta både operativt och strategiskt. Du är nyfiken, flexibel och ser förändring som en naturlig möjlighet att utveckla och förbättra arbetssätt och lösningar. Dessutom är du ödmjuk, prestigelös och tillmötesgående i din kommunikation med kollegor och samarbetspartner.

###### **Information om tjänsten**

* Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning med sex månaders provanställning.
* Placeringsort: Södermalm i Stockholm.
* Lön: Enligt överenskommelse

##### **Vad erbjuder vi?**

* Ett arbete i en organisation där värderingar är viktiga och där vårt gemensamma mål är att få fler att upptäcka Sverige. Våra värdeord omtänksam, nyfiken, äkta, professionell och engagerad genomsyrar hela vår organisation och arbetssätt.
* Härliga kollegor och ett trevligt kontor på Södermalm i Stockholm, nära bra kommunikationer.
* Möjlighet till distansarbete två dagar i veckan.
* Bra villkor och kollektivavtal.

description:

Office**Job Description**


As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

 **Location/Division Specific Information:**

**Olink**, part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, is dedicated to advancing the understanding of human disease through proteomics. Olink panels provide innovative, high-quality solutions for human protein biomarker discovery, enabling researchers to measure thousands of proteins simultaneously from just a few microliters of blood. Using highly specific and thoroughly validated assays with a wide dynamic range, Olink’s technology overcomes traditional limitations in protein analysis and supports deeper insights into human biology and disease.

 **Job description:**


We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced **Senior Data Engineer** with knowledge of AWS to contribute to the development of our internal data and analytics platform. The platform support our R&D organisation with advanced analysis tooling and data processing. In the role as Data Engineer, you will be part of a team focusing both on the core part of the platform and data ingestion pipelines as well as contributing to the development of advanced analysis tools and automations in cross functional initiatives. You will work and closely collaborate with our AI analysis team and software development team. This role is based in our Uppsala office.  



  

**A day in the Life:**

* Implement a robust and scalable environment in AWS using best practices whenever applicable.
* Design and develop robust data pipelines for ingestion and transformations
* Model and design for optimized data processing performance, ensuring efficient use of resources and adherence to best practices.
* Troubleshoot and resolve data-related issues, providing technical guidance and support to team members and stakeholders
* Contribute with up-to-date industry standards, trends, and advancements in the data engineering field, applying new techniques and technologies as appropriate.

**Requirements:**
-----------------

* Master of Science in Molecular Biotechnology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical field.
* Minimum of 7 years of experience in data engineering or a similar role.
* Familiarity with data modelling, data warehousing, and big data technologies.
* Strong programming skills in Python or C# is desired
* Background in the biotech industry is beneficial
* Experience with AWS services is beneficial
* Knowledge of Databricks is beneficial

 **Why Join Us?**


At Olink, Thermo Fisher Scientific, you will be part of a nurturing team that values integrity, innovation, and involvement. We offer an encouraging environment where your diverse experiences and perspectives are appreciated, enabling you to thrive and excel in your career.

  

The final date for submitting applications is on the 20th of October. The role could be filled prior to this deadline.

title: Talent Acquisition Coordinator
description:
**Are you a student eager to learn more about HR & recruitment in a large organization?**

  

Whatever your professional title is - with us you will contribute to something bigger. Together, we are providers of possibilities. Giving people the confidence to be curious, explore new worlds, start new businesses, and live their lives.

  

  

**About the role**

  

Be part of the journey taking recruiting to the next level in If, where we strive to create a positive and inspiring candidate experience.

  

You’ll contribute to having a high-quality candidate experience by offering day-to-day support in candidate communication and coordinating recruitment processes with colleagues in HR and recruiting leaders. As a Talent Acquisition Coordinator, you will work with screening of candidates, scheduling interviews, reference calls and other tasks related to recruitment.

  

We appreciate the insight and ideas you can bring us, as well as your contribution in the daily work. You will be involved in recruitment for one of our largest professional groups at If, insurance- and claims advisors.

  

**We offer**


In the same way that we place high demands on you as an employee, we also expect you to place high demands on us as an employer. Here are some of the benefits of working at If:


* An including work environment where everyone is welcome
* Career and development opportunities in the biggest insurance company in the Nordics
* Highly skilled professional environment
* Possibility of a hybrid workplace
* A health promoting workplace with e.g., wellness allowance and various sports activities
* Great insurance benefits and a very high pension saving
  

**About the team**

  

The role is placed in the Talent Acquisition organization in HR. Besides working with your TA-colleagues you might also be in contact with HR colleagues in other teams and recruiting leaders. They will support you to succeed and encourage you in your development journey in If.

  



**Who are you?**


You have an ambition to learn more in the area of recruitment. Your inner drive is strong, you have a sense of responsibility and can be trusted to deliver. You are structured and able to manage multiple tasks at the same time. It is easy for you to create internal and external relations.

  

**You also have:**


* Started a bachelor’s or master’s degree, it is an advantage if you are in the beginning of your studies
* Experience working with some kind of coordinating or administration
* Some work experience within e.g., HR, recruitment or communication is beneficial
* Strong communication skills in Swedish and English, both verbal and written
* Experience working in different systems is beneficial
  

**Additional facts and the recruitment process:**

  

**Application deadline:** 2025-10-09. Screening will start as soon as possible. You can expect to hear from us within three weeks after the application deadline.

  

**Process** : For a fair recruitment process, we are using tests as the first step to assess potential and match with the position. Relevant candidates are then invited to an interview.

  

**To apply for the position:** Please attach your CV. You don’t need to write a motivational letter, instead please answer the quick questions that come up when you are applying. We do not have the possibility to handle your application through mail due to GDPR.  

  



**Work location:** Bergshamra, Stockholm, or Mölndal, Gothenburg with the flexibility to work from home.  

  



**Start:** November 2026  

  



**Schedule:** 16-20 hours a week, in periods you will have the opportunity to work more. Mon-Fri, 8am-5pm, in dialogue with the business.

  

Final candidates will undergo a background check before employment.

  

For more information, please contact Fanny Ryrberg, Talent Acquisition Partner, in Sweden at fanny.ryrberg@if.se.

  

**We look forward to your application!**

* Förmåga att självständigt felsöka och lösa mer komplexa supportärenden.
* Gott tekniskt omdöme och förmåga att avgöra när ett ärende ska lösas direkt respektive eskaleras vidare.
* Ett tydligt service- och användarfokus.
* Förmåga att arbeta strukturerat och behålla kvalitet även vid hög arbetsbelastning.

* Förmåga att samarbeta och stötta mindre erfarna kollegor.

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av:

* ServiceNow, Jira Service Management eller Freshservice.
* AV- och konferenslösningar såsom Neat och Zoom Rooms.

### **ÖVRIGT**
