title: ILS Manager
description:
Söker du en utmanande roll i Stockholm där du kan forma framtidens logistiklösningar? Vi letar efter en
 **ILS Manager** 
 (Integrated Logistics Support Manager) som vill säkerställa att system är tillgängliga, underhållbara och kostnadseffektiva under hela sin livscykel. Här får du arbeta med projektledning, systemutveckling och logistikplanering i en tvärfunktionell miljö.
 



  





**VAD ERBJUDER VI?** 




 Som konsult på ALTEN får du möjlighet att arbeta med utmanande och spännande projekt hos några av våra viktigaste kunder, med:
 


* Tekniska utmaningar och utvecklingsmöjligheter.
* En inspirerande gemenskap och möjlighet att bidra till en hållbar framtid.
* Stöttande och coachande ledarskap.
* Möjlighet att arbeta inom olika branscher där våra kunder verkar.
* En personlig utbildningsbudget för interna eller externa kurser.



  





**Om rollen** 




 Som ILS Manager spelar du en central roll i att designa, implementera och optimera logistikstöd för projekt. Du kommer att samarbeta nära med team inom systemkonstruktion, hårdvara, mjukvara och design för att säkerställa att lösningar möter både tekniska och operativa krav.
 



  





 Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter:
 


* Utveckla och implementera ILS-planer, underhållsplaner, utbildningsplaner och dokumentationsplaner.
* Leda ILS-arbete i projekt av olika storlek och komplexitet.
* Samarbeta med kunder, leverantörer och interna team för att säkerställa att logistikstödet är anpassat till projektets behov.
* Bidra till robusthet, testbarhet och underhållsmässighet i konstruktioner och system.
* Säkerställa hög tillgänglighet och effektivitet i system genom helhetslösningar.
* Driva interna processer och bidra till utvecklingen av ILS-området.



  





**Din profil** 




 Vi söker dig som har:
 


* Teknisk utbildning (t.ex. civilingenjör, högskoleingenjör, eller motsvarande erfarenhet från arbetslivet).
* Erfarenhet av projektledning och arbete i tvärfunktionella team.
* Kunskap om ILS-standarder (t.ex. MIL-STD-1388-2A, DEF STAN 00-600) och praktiskt ILS-arbete, såsom underhållsberedning, ILS-planering eller felmodsanalyser (FMEA).
* Förmåga att snabbt sätta dig in i nya sammanhang och förstå hur tekniska komponenter samverkar i ett system.
* Flexibilitet, samarbetsförmåga och resultatdrivenhet – du trivs med att ta ansvar och driva projekt framåt.



  





**OM ALTEN** 




 ALTEN är ett av Europas största teknik- och IT-konsultföretag med över 57 000 anställda cirka 30 länder. Våra ingenjörer utför komplexa och mycket tekniska projekt genom helaproduktutvecklingskedjan hos de främsta företagen inom flera olika branscher såsom Fordon, Försvar & Säkerhet, Energi, Industriell utrustning, Public service samt Life sciences. I Sverige är vi cirka 1300 engagerade medarbetare med 9 kontor i 9 städer - från Lund i söder till Skellefteå i norr.
 



  





 ALTEN har för femte året i rad utsetts till en av Sveriges mest attraktiva arbetsgivare av Karriärföretagen, en utmärkelse för arbetsgivare som erbjuder unika karriär- och utvecklingsmöjligheter.
 



  





 Välkommen in att läsa mer om oss på alten.se

title: Sr. Named Account Manager, Nordics
description:
**About Us**
 Proofpoint is a global leader in human- and agent-centric cybersecurity. We protect how people, data, and AI agents connect across email, cloud, and collaboration tools. Over 80 of the Fortune 100, 10,000 large enterprises, and millions of smaller organizations trust Proofpoint to stop threats, prevent data loss, and build resilience across their people and AI workflows. Our mission is simple safeguard the digital world and empower people to work securely and confidently. Join us in our pursuit to defend data and protect people.
   

  

**How We Work**
 At Proofpoint you’ll be part of a global team that breaks barriers to redefine cybersecurity guided by our BRAVE core values
   

  

**Bold** 
 in how we dream and innovate
   

  

**Responsive** 
 to feedback, challenges and opportunities
   

  

**Accountable** 
 for results and best in class outcomes
   

  

**Visionary** 
 in future focused problem-solving
   

  

**Exceptional** 
 in execution and impact
   

  

**About The Role**
 We’re looking for a proactive, strategic, and results-driven Sr. Named Account Manager to accelerate Proofpoint’s growth across the Nordics. This position will work closely with the Team Lead for Northern Europe and report directly to the SVP of EMEA. This position will own and grow a portfolio of named enterprise accounts, combining new business acquisition (main focus) with expansion of existing relationships. You’ll work closely with System Engineers, Channel Partners, and internal stakeholders to develop strategies that protect customers from advanced threats and enable long-term success.
   

  

**Your Day-to-Day**
* Build and maintain strong executive-level relationships within enterprise accounts (2,500+ end users) across multiple verticals
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders (System Engineers, Channel Partners) to develop and execute account strategies.
* Drive new business acquisition while expanding relationships with existing customers by introducing our full suite of security, compliance, and information protection solutions.
* Deliver compelling product demonstrations and presentations in partnership with technical teams.
* Analyse and report on pipeline progression, forecast accuracy, and account performance.
* Manage the end-to-end sales process, ensuring operational excellence and timely execution.
* Maintain compliance with Proofpoint’s sales methodology and industry best practices.


**Qualifications**
* Required
* Proven success in enterprise technology sales, ideally with SaaS and cybersecurity solutions.
* Track record of exceeding quotas, winning new logos, and leveraging channel partnerships.
* Strong executive selling skills (CISO, CIO, CMO) and ability to influence complex buying cycles.
* Experience closing deals in the €100K–€1M range.
* Familiarity with formal sales methodologies (MEDDIC, Challenger, TAS, Command of the Message).
* Preferably bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
* Fluent in Swedish & English.
* Preferred
* Knowledge of cybersecurity market trends and competitive landscape.
* Experience using Salesforce


* Soft Skills
+ Growth mindset and willingness to be coached.
+ Strong communication, relationship-building, and problem-solving skills.
+ Entrepreneurial approach with urgency and strategic thinking.


**Why Proofpoint?**
 At Proofpoint, we believe that an exceptional career experience includes a comprehensive compensation and benefits package. Here are just a few reasons you’ll love working with us
   

  

* Competitive compensation
* Comprehensive benefits
* Career success on your terms
* Flexible work environment
* Annual wellness and community outreach days
* Always on recognition for your contributions
* Global collaboration and networking opportunities


**Our Culture**
 Our culture is rooted in values that inspire belonging, empower purpose and drive success-every day, for everyone.
   

  

 We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. If you need accommodation during the application or interview process, please reach out to accessibility@proofpoint.com.
   

  

**How To Apply**
 Interested? Submit your application along with any supporting information- we can’t wait to hear from you!

title: Business Development Manager (AI Products and Solutions)
description:
We at Sigma Software are looking for a Business Development Manager to join our growing AI direction. This role is ideal for a professional with experience in innovative digital solutions and business development within the IT industry.
   

  





 Our team focuses on delivering advanced AI-powered platforms, intelligent automation solutions, and machine learning applications for global clients.
   

  





 At Sigma Software, you will become part of an innovative international team where your expertise will help shape the future of AI technologies.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**
* Seeking and targeting new customers and sales opportunities, initiating action plans to approach and secure new business for the Company, with a focus on AI-driven solutions and services
* Participating personally and actively in the sales process, delivering presentations to customers, developing new opportunities, and managing customers throughout the entire sales cycle
* Identifying the expectations and constraints of potential clients and ensuring that the Company’s proposals align with their business needs in the best possible way
* Driving the contract signing process and related negotiations
* Preparing and developing relevant documentation, including case studies, contracts, work orders, presentations, and other sales materials
* Ensuring a smooth transition of new accounts to the Delivery team
* Maintaining accurate and up-to-date records in the sales CRM, ensuring all relevant information is properly documented and proposals meet profitability KPIs
* Building and continuously expanding a strong network of professional connections relevant to the Company’s services
* Continuously increasing company revenue and expanding the customer base
* Analyzing relevant conferences, AI-related events, and market opportunities
* Maintaining a high level of expertise in focus domains through continuous learning

**Qualifications**
* Higher education degree
* 3+ years of experience in business development or sales within IT/software development, with proven success in AI-related projects (BFSI)
* Proven track record of successfully completing complex AI proposals and formal tenders involving cross-functional teams
* Advanced English
* Knowledge of software development processes and AI solution lifecycles
* Experience preparing proposals and presentation materials for AI-powered solutions
* Strong negotiation, business communication, and conflict resolution skills
* Ability to work accurately, stay organized, and pay attention to details

title: Agile Coach
description:
Vi söker nu en erfaren Agile Coach till ett långsiktigt konsultuppdrag hos en ledande aktör inom den nordiska försäkringsbranschen. Uppdraget passar dig som drivs av att utveckla organisationers förmåga att skapa värde, förbättra leveranskapacitet och stärka samarbetet mellan team och ledning.
   

  

**OM UPPDRAGET // MAKE IMPACT WHERE IT MATTERS**
 I rollen kommer du att arbeta nära både utvecklingsteam, Scrum Masters och ledningsgrupper för att identifiera förbättringsmöjligheter, driva förändringsinitiativ och bidra till en mer effektiv leveransmodell. Fokus ligger på att förbättra flödet från idé till produktion, stärka ägarskap och självständighet i teamen samt utveckla arbetssätt som möjliggör snabbare och mer värdeskapande leveranser.
   

  

 Du förväntas vara en proaktiv förändringsledare som själv identifierar behov och möjligheter, samtidigt som du skapar samsyn mellan olika intressenter genom stark facilitering, kommunikation och visualisering.
   

  

**UPPDRAGSINFORMATION**
* Placeringsort: Stockholm
* Uppdragsperiod: 9–12 månader
* Start: Så snart som möjligt
* Omfattning: 100 %
* Arbetssätt: Hybrid. Närvaro på kontoret minst tre dagar per vecka önskas.
* Resor: Enstaka resor till nordiska kontor kan förekomma enligt överenskommelse.


**DIN PROFIL // YOU BRING THE EDGE**
 För att lyckas i uppdraget ser vi att du har:
   

  

* Erfarenhet av att coacha både team och ledningsgrupper.
* Erfarenhet från större agila organisationer.
* God förståelse för moderna metoder inom mjukvaruutveckling och produktutveckling.
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta i miljöer där ägarskap och ansvar är distribuerat över flera team.
* Mycket god förmåga att kommunicera och hantera olika intressenter.
* Mycket stark faciliteringsförmåga, särskilt i workshops och möten med flera intressenter.
* Förmåga och vilja att resa mellan verksamhetens kontor vid behov.
* Flytande svenska i tal och skrift.
* Mycket god engelska i tal och skrift.
* Förmåga att arbeta både strategiskt och operativt.


**Meriterande**
* Erfarenhet av moderna engineering practices.
* Erfarenhet av DevOps-arbetssätt.
* Erfarenhet av AI-stödd mjukvaruutveckling.


**Personliga egenskaper**
* Proaktiv och självgående.
* Initiativtagande och förändringsdriven.
* Stark samarbetsförmåga.
* Förmåga att skapa engagemang och samsyn.
* Strukturerad och resultatorienterad.


**OM ORGANISATIONEN // CULTURE WITH REAL CHARACTER**
 Du kommer att arbeta hos en etablerad nordisk organisation som befinner sig på en kontinuerlig resa inom digitalisering och enterprise agility. Här får du möjlighet att påverka arbetssätt, leveransförmåga och organisationsutveckling i en komplex miljö där samarbete, innovation och ständiga förbättringar står i fokus.
   

  

**NÄR DU BLIR PARTNER**
 Som partnerkonsult hos Wise kliver du in i en gemenskap där samarbete är kärnan. Du får möjlighet att arbeta med några av marknadens mest intressanta uppdrag, i organisationer där både människor och teknik är i centrum. För oss är det avgörande att du känner dig trygg och värdesatt i vårt samarbete. Vi stöttar dig, coachar dig och finns med dig hela vägen genom uppdraget. Hos oss är du inte bara konsult – du blir en del av en större helhet.
   

  

**OM WISE IT**
 Wise IT är specialister på rekrytering, konsultlösningar och strategisk kompetensmatchning inom IT och tech. Teknik förändras snabbt, men med rätt person på rätt plats får du kontroll på framtiden. Vi matchar människor med skarp teknisk kompetens och förmågan att förstå helheten. Resultatet? IT som fungerar i praktiken, inte bara i teorin. Vi ser till att du inte bara följer utvecklingen utan driver den.
   

  

**DIN ANSÖKAN // TALENT SPEAKS LOUDER**
 För att söka rollen klicka på ”Ansök nu”, samt bifoga CV. Notera att vi ej kan ta emot ansökningar via mail. I konsultvärlden går det ofta snabbt så tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum. Vänta därför inte med din ansökan.

title: CS Data Operation Manager (1 year temp)
description:
At Viaplay Group, we entertain millions of people every day through our streaming services, radio networks, and TV channels. We believe in the power of content not just as a way of telling stories and touching lives, but also expanding worlds.
   

  

 We’re looking for the best people to join us on our journey. Right now, we’re searching for a CS Data Operation Manager in our Stockholm office – are you ready to hit play on an exciting career change?
   

  

**(Note that this is a temporary employment for 1 year)**
 The role
   

  

 As a
 **CS Data Operations Manager** 
 , you will drive data-informed decision making across the Customer Service organization by managing reporting, forecasting, KPI tracking, and financial follow-up. You will transform complex data into clear, actionable insights that support operational performance, strategic planning, and continuous improvement initiatives. You will collaborate closely with stakeholders across Customer Service and the wider business, providing meaningful analysis and recommendations that drive business outcomes.
   

  

 What we’re looking for
   

  

**Role**
 We understand you may feel confident ticking certain boxes more than others and that’s why we always keep an open mind in our recruitment process. But, in order to thrive in this role, we do believe you’ll have at least some experience in the following:
   

  

* You are a curious, analytical, and data-driven person who loves turning numbers into insights and insights into action. You enjoy digging into data, spotting trends, and finding opportunities to improve both performance and ways of working.
* You are comfortable working with reporting, forecasting, KPIs, and financial follow-up, and you can translate complex data into clear and useful insights for different stakeholders. You take ownership of your work, are highly organized, and enjoy improving processes, dashboards, and tools along the way.
* We believe you are a great communicator and a collaborative team player who is also comfortable working independently. Most importantly, you are proactive, solution-oriented, and always looking for ways to make things better.


**It’s a bonus if you have:**
* Experience in Excel and PowerPoint
* A good understanding of data visualization
* Understanding what metrics are relevant and why
* Experience in customer service and working with BPOs
* 5+ years of experience in a data analyst position


 What we offer you
   

  

**We’ve got you covered!** 
 30 days of paid vacation every year, an attractive pension and insurance scheme, and generous parental leave pay lift.
   

  

**Your wellbeing matters.** 
 We provide you with various wellbeing initiatives including wellness allowance.
   

  

**A safe space to grow and up-skill.** 
 Our learning culture puts you in the driver’s seat of your own development.
   

  

**Entertainment is what we love, and entertainment is what we do** 
 . So, unlimited access to Viaplay seems only fair for you to get to know the product – including series & viewing events, new release movie rentals, linear channels and more.
   

  

 Hit play today
   

  

 If this feels like your kind of challenge, make sure you apply by attaching your CV here – you may also want to add your LinkedIn profile. Please don’t send us your application via email because we won’t be able to accept it. We do, however, welcome any questions you may have about this particular position.
   

  

 Want to learn more about who we are and what we do? Check out our careers page or follow us on Instagram! We’re only ever a few clicks away.

title: Doctoral student in AI and clinical data science for breast cancer
description:
****Do you want to contribute to top quality medical research?****




*To be a doctoral student means to devote oneself to a research project under supervision of experienced researchers and following an individual study plan. For a doctoral degree, the equivalent of four years of full-time doctoral education is required.*




****The research group****




 The doctoral student will be based at the Department of Oncology-Pathology, Karolinska Institutet, within the Computational Breast Imaging Group led by Associate Professor Fredrik Strand. The group is internationally recognized for the development and evaluation of AI for breast cancer imaging and precision medicine, combining expertise in radiology, machine learning, and biostatistics. It comprises PhD students, research engineers, research assistants, postdoctoral researchers, and collaborating senior clinicians in radiology, pathology, oncology, and surgery. The group has active national collaborations (KTH, Lund University, the Institute for Future Studies, and several groups at KI) and international collaborations (among others UC Berkeley, UCSF, University of Hawaii, and University of Barcelona). Available infrastructure includes high-performance computing, GDPR-compliant secure storage, the VAI.B platform, and a large linked retrospective breast cancer cohort with imaging, clinical documentation, and registry data. The doctoral student will be supervised by Apostolia Tsirikoglou, PhD, Lead AI Scientist in the group, as main supervisor, together with Associate Professor Fredrik Strand, head of the group and principal investigator of the project, as co-supervisor.
   

  





****The doctoral student project and the duties of the doctoral student****




 This PhD project develops agent-based data infrastructure and methods for transforming longitudinal, multimodal data into structured clinical decision-state representations and benchmark datasets for correctness-oriented evaluation of AI-supported multidisciplinary decision-making. Breast cancer care involves complex, longitudinal decisions across radiology, pathology, surgery, oncology, and multidisciplinary tumor boards, based on evolving information distributed across imaging, reports, clinical notes, and registries. Current AI systems are typically built for isolated tasks and rarely capture the temporal and multidisciplinary structure of real clinical decision-making.
   

  





 The work combines data engineering, machine learning, and language technologies, and uses a large retrospective breast cancer cohort (more than 30,000 cases) linked to the National Quality Register for Breast Cancer. The project is conducted in close collaboration with clinical specialists.
   

  





 The doctoral student is expected to take an active and increasingly independent role in formulating research questions, developing methods, working with clinical data, collaborating with clinicians and computer scientists, writing scientific publications, and presenting results at international conferences.
   

  





****What do we offer?****




 A creative and inspiring environment full of expertise and curiosity. Karolinska Institutet is one of the world's leading medical universities. Our vision is to pursue the development of knowledge about life and to promote a better health for all. At Karolinska Institutet, we conduct successful medical research and hold the largest range of medical education in Sweden. As a doctoral student you are offered an individual research project, a well-educated supervisor, a vast range of elective courses and the opportunity to work in a leading research group. Karolinska Institutet collaborates with prominent universities from all around the world, which ensures opportunities for international exchanges. You will be employed on a doctoral studentship which means that you receive a contractual salary. Employees also have access to our modern gym for free and receive reimbursements for medical care.
   

  





****Eligibility requirements for doctoral education****




 In order to participate in the selection for a doctoral position, you must meet the following general
 **(A)** 
 and specific
 **(B)** 
 eligibility requirements at latest by the application deadline.
   

  





 It is your responsibility to certify eligibility by following the instructions on the web page Entry requirements (eligibility) for doctoral education.
   

  





**A) General eligibility requirement**




 You meet the general eligibility requirement for doctoral/third-cycle/PhD education if you:
 


* have been awarded a second-cycle/advanced/master qualification (i.e. master degree),
 **or**
* have satisfied the requirements for courses comprising at least 240 credits of which at least 60 credits were awarded in the advanced/second-cycle/master level,
 **or**
* have acquired substantially equivalent knowledge in some other way in Sweden or abroad.\*



 Follow the instructions on the web page Entry requirements (eligibility) for doctoral education.
   

  





 \*If you claim equivalent knowledge, follow the instructions on the web page Assessing equivalent knowledge for general eligibility for doctoral education.
   

  





  
   

  





**B) Specific eligibility requirement**




 You meet the specific eligibility requirement for doctoral/third-cycle/PhD education if you:
   

  





 - Show proficiency in English equivalent to the course English B/English 6 at Swedish upper secondary school.
   

  





 Follow the instructions on the web page English language requirements for doctoral education.
   

  





*Verification of your documents* 
 Karolinska Institutet checks the authenticity of your documents. Karolinska Institutet reserves the right to revoke admission if supporting documents are discovered to be fraudulent. Submission of false documents is a violation of Swedish law and is considered grounds for legal action.
   

  





**(A)** 
 and
 **(B)** 
**can only** 
 be certified by the documentation requirement for doctoral education.
   

  





****Skills and personal qualities****




**Necessary:** 



* A master's degree (or equivalent) in image analysis, machine learning, computer science, biomedical engineering, data science, or a related field
* Solid programming skills, in particular Python
* Experience with machine learning and/or image analysis
* Experience with data engineering, data pipelines, or working with heterogeneous data sources
* Strong analytical ability and interest in interdisciplinary research at the intersection of AI and clinical medicine
* Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a multidisciplinary team
* Excellent written and spoken English
 
**Desirable/advantageous:**
* Experience with health data standards (e.g. FHIR, OMOP, DICOM) or clinical data
* Experience with multimodal data integration or temporal/longitudinal data
* Familiarity with containerization and reproducible research workflows (e.g. Docker)
* Interest in trustworthy AI, evaluation methodology, and clinical translation



**Terms and conditions**




 The doctoral student will be employed on a doctoral studentship for a maximum of 4 years full-time. The position can also be held part-time, at a minimum of 50%.
   

  





****Terms and conditions****




 The doctoral student will be employed on a doctoral studentship maximum 4 years full-time.
   

  





****Application process****




 Submit your application and supporting documents through the Varbi recruitment system. Use the button in the top right corner and follow the instructions. We prefer that your application is written in English, but you can also apply in Swedish.
   

  





 Your application must contain the following documents:
   

  





 - A personal letter and a curriculum vitae
   

  





 - Degree projects and previous publications, if any
   

  





 - Any other documentation showing the desirable skills and personal qualities described above
   

  





 - Documents certifying your general eligibility (see
 **A** 
 above)
   

  





 - Documents certifying your specific eligibility (see
 **B** 
 above)
   

  





****Selection****




 A selection will be made among eligible applicants on the basis of the ability to benefit from doctoral education. The qualifications of the applicants will be evaluated on an overall basis.
   

  





 Karolinska Institutet uses the following bases of assessment:
   

  





 - Documented subject knowledge of relevance to the area of research
   

  





 - Analytical skill
   

  





 - Other documented knowledge or experience that may be relevant to doctoral studies in the subject.
   

  





 All applicants will be informed when the recruitment is completed.
   

  





 KI applies a salary scale when setting salaries for doctoral students. 
   

  





 Apply at the latest
 **20th October** 
 .

title: SE - Product Manager (GTM)
description:
Join us to shape the future of work: your next adventure awaits!
   

  

 Do you want to combine strategy, product and business? As a Go-to-Market Manager at Job&Talent, you will drive initiatives from idea to results and create real value for our customers.
   

  

**The position**
 We are looking for a Go-to-Market Manager who wants to help develop how we create value for our customers through our platform.
   

  

 This is a broad and hands-on role at the intersection of product, customer development and operations. You will work closely with the Swedish business and our customers to identify new growth opportunities, understand business needs and ensure that our product and ways of working develop in the right direction.
   

  

 You will also act as an important link between the Swedish organisation and our product and development teams. This means you need to be able to go from a commercial or operational problem to analysis, hypothesis and clear requirements, and then drive the work all the way through to implementation and follow-up.
   

  

 The role is suited to someone who thrives in a fast-moving environment where not all the answers are available from the start. You combine strategic and analytical thinking with strong drive and ownership to make things happen.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Develop our customers through the platform. Work together with the commercial organisation to identify how product functionality and new ways of working can increase customers' usage, efficiency and value from the platform.
* Be the link between the business and product/tech. Capture and prioritise needs from customers and the Swedish business, and translate them into business cases and priorities for the Swedish market.
* Lead the launch and implementation of new features. Take responsibility for the Swedish rollout of new products and features, from planning and stakeholder alignment to launch, implementation and follow-up.
* Drive initiatives from idea to results. Project-manage initiatives together with Account Management and Sales and ensure that they are translated into actual value for the business.
* Work in a data-driven way. Analyse results, outcomes and user data, formulate hypotheses, define relevant KPIs and use the results to prioritise and develop our initiatives.
* Communicate recommendations and create alignment. Structure complex questions and present clear recommendations, business cases and decision-making materials to both internal stakeholders and customers.


**You have…**
* 4–6+ years of relevant professional experience, for example from management consulting, Strategy & Operations, Business Operations, Commercial Operations within tech or a similar role.
* Experience leading strategic, commercial or operational projects and driving initiatives from analysis and idea through to implementation.
* Strong analytical problem-solving skills and experience working in a data-driven way.
* Experience working cross-functionally, preferably closely with both commercial teams and product/development organisations.
* The ability to prepare and present clear decision-making materials and recommendations.
* Experience from a fast-growing or fast-moving organisation.
* Relevant post-secondary education in areas such as industrial engineering and management, economics, engineering or business, alternatively equivalent knowledge gained through professional experience.
* Very good Swedish and English, both written and spoken.


**Nice if you are also have...**
* Experience from B2B SaaS, marketplace, staffing/HR-tech or other digital platform businesses.
* Experience with product-related work, including product launches and go-to-market.
* Experience with customer dialogue and customer presentations.
* Good understanding of KPIs and business cases.
* Experience with BI/analytics tools and very good knowledge of Excel/Google Sheets.


**About Us**
 Job&Talent is a world-leading, AI-powered workforce management platform for frontline industries. We help companies boost productivity and efficiency at scale, while giving workers the tools they need to thrive. Our mission is simple: to empower the people who make the world go round.
   

  

 Built on deep industry expertise, cutting-edge technology, and smart AI agents, our end-to-end platform covers the entire workforce lifecycle — from recruitment and planning to time and attendance, performance, cost management, and communication.
   

  

 It delivers measurable improvements in the areas that matter most: fulfilment, attendance, retention, and workforce quality. Our platform strength is rooted in unique experience: placing millions of workers over the years and serving thousands of blue-chip clients across delivery, logistics, manufacturing, e-commerce, retail, and hospitality.
   

  

 Headquartered in Madrid, the company operates in 10 countries across Europe, the US, and Latin America and is backed by leading investors including Atomico, Goldman Sachs, Kinnevik, BlackRock, and SoftBank.
   

  

**Join our community and make an impact**
 Innovation, high standards, and analytical thinking are in our DNA. Everyone has a voice here, and that voice matters. It’s how we stay sharp, move fast, and make decisions that keep us ahead of the curve.
   

  

 You’ll take full ownership of your work, collaborate across borders, and grow by doing. Around here, you’ll hear a lot about 10x experiences, human-centered design, and the power of AI. But what truly sets us apart is our people: Our diverse team brings unique perspectives, deep commitment and real-world experience to the table.
   

  

 We champion empathy, honesty, and inclusion. Because when people can be their authentic selves, incredible things happen—for our workers, our clients, and for each other.
   

  

 And we reward that impact—with competitive pay, meaningful benefits, and the opportunity to shape what work looks like for millions around the globe.
   

  

 If you're ready to make a real impact at scale, you're in the right place.
   

  

**Proud to champion equality**
 At Job&Talent we value diversity and we're an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified people regardless of national origin, race, disability, religious beliefs or sexual orientation. Come join us. We look forward to your application.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Senior Product Manager — Defence
description:
**Readiness stopped being paperwork**
 Armed forces spend almost all of their existence preparing for a day they hope never comes. Readiness is the whole of that work — how forces are trained, how that training is planned across years and budgets, how performance is assessed, and whether anyone can demonstrate, with evidence rather than assertion, that a unit can do what is being asked of it.
   

  

 For a generation, much of Europe treated this as an administrative exercise. It is not one now. The institutions we serve are rebuilding readiness at a pace and scale they have not attempted in decades, and they are being asked to prove it as they go.
   

  

 Exonaut is the platform they do it on.
   

  

**Why this is a hard product job**
 The work is not difficult because the screens are complicated. It is difficult because of what the evidence has to survive.
   

  

 A readiness assessment written today may be read years from now by someone deciding whether a unit is fit to deploy, or by an auditor asking how a conclusion was reached. It has to hold up. That means information with structure and provenance rather than a document anyone can quietly overwrite, systems that pass security review before they are allowed anywhere near a network, and working alongside the tools an institution already runs and has no intention of abandoning.
   

  

 It also means respecting how these institutions actually work. They have doctrine, terminology and processes established long before we arrived, and they will not reshape them to suit a piece of software. Yet a platform that bends to every customer in turn stops being a platform at all.
   

  

 That tension is the job: what belongs in the core, what stays configurable, and what we decline to build. Get those calls right and the platform compounds. Get them wrong and it becomes a very expensive spreadsheet.
   

  

**The role**
 You will own a product area outright, as a senior individual contributor — the judgement, the strategy and the outcome, not a backlog to administer.
   

  

 Which area you take on is settled with you, once we understand where your strengths land. We would rather match a strong product manager to the right problem than hire against a box we wrote before we met you.
   

  

 Day to day:
   

  

* Work with the people who use it: planners, analysts and officers who have to prepare forces and be able to prove they are ready
* Turn a complex, institutional problem space into a strategy people can act on
* Work as co-owner with engineering and design, from discovery through delivery to measured outcome
* Decide what not to build, and defend that decision with evidence
* Weigh national and institutional variation against a coherent product: what generalises, what stays configurable, and what is one customer's problem alone


**What We Are Looking For**
* Product management at senior level — you own the strategy for an area, not features within someone else's, and you have been doing it long enough to have lived with the results
* A track record spanning discovery to delivery — you have found problems, not only shipped solutions
* Comfort with complex, regulated, slow-moving customers, and the patience that requires
* Structured thinking about metrics and evidence, paired with genuine qualitative insight
* Influence without authority across engineering, design, delivery and commercial
* Swedish citizenship (see below)
* Professional English, written and spoken — English is our working language


**Merits, not requirements:**
* Military service, or experience from the armed forces, a defence agency or the defence industry
* Swedish language
* Experience in another domain where procurement is slow, accreditation matters and buyers are institutions rather than individuals


 Domain knowledge can be learned. Product judgement is harder to teach, so that is what we weight most heavily.
   

  

**Security and citizenship**
 Because of the customers we serve, this role requires
 **Swedish citizenship** 
 . Holding another citizenship in addition is not a barrier.
   

  

 The role is subject to a security check before you start, and we take up ordinary employment references. We will explain exactly what that involves early in the process — nothing about it should surprise you late on.
   

  

**How We Hire**
 We publish our process, because a good interview should not be a surprise. You will meet:
   

  

* Hiring manager screen
* Product sense and strategy
* Execution and delivery
* Collaboration and influence
* Analytical acumen
* Culture interview
* Your questions — time set aside for you to interrogate us


 Every interview has a written script and a scored rubric, applied the same way for every candidate. We tell you what each session covers before it happens.
   

  

**Practicalities**
 Stockholm-based and hybrid: we expect office presence, with flexibility around it. Permanent, full-time.
   

  

 Apply with your CV and a short note on one product decision you got right and one you got wrong.

title: Regional Telecom Growth Lead
description:
Working at Infobip means being part of something truly global. With 75+ offices across six continents, we’re not just building technology — we’re shaping how more than 80% of the world connects and communicates.
   

  

 As employees, we take pride in contributing to the world’s largest and only full-stack cloud communication platform. But it’s not just what we do, it’s how we do it: with curiosity, passion, and a whole lot of collaboration.
   

  

 We operate with an AI-first mindset, embedding intelligent tools into our daily workflows to work smarter and more efficiently. Every role here benefits from and contributes to this approach.
   

  

 If you're looking for meaningful work and challenges that grow you in a culture where people show up with purpose, this is your opportunity.
   

  

 Let’s build what’s next, together.
   

  

**What This Role Is All About**
 As a Regional Telecom Growth Lead, you will drive the growth of telecom-focused revenue streams across your assigned region by combining industry expertise, strategic thinking, and close cross-functional collaboration. You will work closely with HQ Telecom Growth Leads, Revenue teams, Marketing, Partnerships, and Product teams to customize and execute go-to-market strategies for SaaS, CPaaS, services, and emerging technology solutions sold to and through telecoms. Acting as a regional telecom industry expert, you will stay closely connected to market trends, customer challenges, and competitive developments while identifying opportunities to strengthen Infobip’s position with telecom operators as customers, partners, and suppliers. Alongside regional telecom growth responsibilities, you will also continue to manage a smaller operational region as an OP Manager.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Drive the rollout of regional telecom go-to-market strategies for SaaS, CPaaS, services, and emerging technology revenue streams in collaboration with HQ Telecom Growth Leads
* Monitor telecom industry trends, CX transformation initiatives, and competitive developments to build regional market insights and identify growth opportunities
* Contribute to telecom-focused go-to-market planning in key regions and countries with the goal of improving pipeline growth, sales velocity, and win rates
* Define and execute solution and sales initiatives together with Revenue, Product, and Marketing teams to increase adoption of telecom-focused offerings
* Coordinate regional sales, cross-sell, upsell, and marketing initiatives aimed at growing telecom-related revenue streams and achieving business targets
* Foster collaboration and knowledge sharing within telecom-focused sales communities across the region through aligned frameworks and initiatives
* Represent Infobip in telecom industry events, associations, and customer engagements while promoting telecom CX transformation initiatives
* Analyze telecom customer and partner use cases, revenue streams, market feedback, and lost opportunities to support continuous improvement of the telecom consultancy offering
* Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Partnerships teams to identify gaps, optimize offers, and explore high-potential telecom opportunities in regional markets
* Participate in strategic account planning sessions with cross-functional teams supporting key telecom accounts
* Track telecom sales opportunities and pipeline performance while identifying process improvements that support stronger business results
* Identify and develop strategically important telecom opportunities across the assigned sub-region
* Lead and coordinate telecom sales processes from opportunity identification through deployment and commercial activation


**What Makes You a Strong Fit**
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Telecommunications, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
* Experience in telecom, SaaS, CPaaS, digital transformation, enterprise technology, or a related B2B technology environment
* Understanding of telecom industry trends, customer engagement technologies, and go-to-market strategies
* Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams including Sales, Marketing, Product, Partnerships, or Revenue organizations
* Ability to analyze market trends, customer needs, pipeline data, and business performance to identify growth opportunities
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills in customer-facing and internal environments
* Strategic mindset combined with an execution-focused approach to delivering business initiatives
* Ability to manage multiple initiatives across regional markets and work effectively in a fast-changing environment
* Fluent in English, both spoken and written


**Nice-to-have Qualifications**
* Experience working with telecom operators or telecom-focused enterprise accounts
* Familiarity with CX transformation, customer engagement platforms, AI-driven communication solutions, or emerging telecom technologies
* Experience participating in industry events, partnerships, or telecom ecosystem initiatives
* Experience using AI tools or data-driven approaches to support business planning, market analysis, or sales execution


**Why you'll love it here**
* Financial rewards & recognition - A fair compensation aligned with your experience, industry, and market standards, performance-driven bonuses, regular reviews to support your growth and recognize your contributions, and a culture that values your impact.
* Flexible work arrangements - We combine in-person collaboration with remote work and flexible working hours, because great ideas happen everywhere - and not always between 9 and 5.
* ESOP (Employee Stock Ownership Plan) - As an Infobip employee, you’ll have the opportunity to share in our company’s success through stock options.
* Work-life balance and Well-being  - We offer time off when you need it, special leave days for life’s big moments, and a flexible hybrid work model tailored to local regulations.
* Career mobility - Your career is a journey. With internal mobility, upskilling, and mentorship, we help you shape your path.
* Professional development - Learning never stops. Onboarding, mentorship, and training programs help you grow - no matter where you start.
* International mobility - Ready to take your career global? Explore short and long-term opportunities in our Hubs worldwide.  While some benefits may vary by location, our goal remains the same: to support your growth, well-being, and success - wherever you are.  Diversity drives connection


**Infobip is built on diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and talents.** 
 We’re proud to be an equal-opportunity employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace.
   

  

 No matter your race, gender, age, background, or identity — if you have the passion and skills to thrive, there’s a place for you here.
   

  

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, national origin, citizenship, disability, veteran status or any other part of one's identity.**
 Read more about our hiring process.

title: Strategy and Operations Project Intern (GBS) - 2026 Start (BS/MS)
description:
**Responsibilities**
 Team Introduction
   

  

 The Global Monetization Strategy & Operations (MSO) team is a high-impact unit at the center of TikTok’s global advertising business. We partner with leaders to shape strategy, set revenue plans, design incentive policies, and build the operational foundations that enable TikTok to scale. Our work spans markets and functions, requiring sharp problem-solving, rigorous analysis, and the ability to execute in complex environments.
   

  

 As a project intern, you will have the opportunity to engage in impactful short-term projects that provide you with a glimpse of professional real-world experience. You will gain practical skills through on-the-job learning in a fast-paced work environment and develop a deeper understanding of your career interests.
   

  

 Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis - we encourage you to apply early.
   

  

 Responsibilities：
   

  

* Develop and deliver analytical reports to track business KPIs, monitor sales metrics and drive insights that shape leadership decisions
* Conduct research and market sizing across industries, translating findings into clear strategic recommendations.
* Support on larger strategic projects within the EU region
* Support conceptualizing and implementing regional projects to increase operational efficiency
* Collaborate with sales and cross-functional stakeholders to identify and resolve operational bottlenecks


**What You Will Learn**
* Gain hands-on experience working in a small, high-performing team and take on meaningful responsibilities from the start of your internship.
* Learn how to support key projects with direct visibility to company leadership.
* Develop cross-market working experience and build a versatile skill set combining strategic thinking, data analytics, and operational execution.
* Understand end-to-end project workflows and how strategic decisions translate into operational delivery.


**Qualifications**
 Minimum Qualifications
   

  

* Available for internship August/September until December 2026
* Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree or higher in Business or Engineering; must be enrolled for the duration of the internship.
* Demonstrated analytical strength and structured problem-solving
* Fast learner, self-driven, and results-oriented
* Good team communication skills and ability to drive projects with multiple stakeholders across organization;
* Fluent in English is required
* Proficiency in Swedish is required to communicate with external clients and content creators in the Swedish market.
* Successful candidates must be able to commit to a 3-6 month Internship (Jan – July 2026 OR July-Dec 2026).


 Preferred Qualifications
   

  

* Relevant internship experience in high-intensity, analytical and fast-paced environments (strategy consulting, investment banking, Private Equity, VC, tech strategy/ops)
* Familiarity with business intelligence tools (e.g., Excel, Tableau, SQL)
* Strong project management and execution capabilities, including stakeholder alignment and delivery under tight timelines.
* Track record of balancing strategic insight with hands-on operational execution.


 By submitting an application for this role, you accept and agree to our global applicant privacy policy, which may be accessed here: https://careers.tiktok.com/legal/privacy
   

  

 Job Information
   

  

**About TikTok**
 TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.
   

  

 Why Join Us
   

  

 Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.
   

  

 We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

title: Senior System Verification Engineer, Medical Devices
description:
**Mission**
 Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.
   

  

 In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're looking for a Senior System Verification Engineer to join the Verification & Validation team. You'll own the system verification strategy for our instruments, including the ME system where it applies, from concept through industrialization, market release, and supporting controlled device updates. You'll work closely with our hardware team, coordinate with firmware and software teams, and work with the manufacturing team to enable an efficient design transfer. You'll help shape requirements so they're testable and traceable, define the test methods that verify them, and keep the traceability record that shows every requirement holds up under regulatory scrutiny.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own the system-level verification strategy for our instruments, including the ME system where devices combine, from concept through industrialization and market release
* Develop verification methods, protocols, and workflows for end-to-end and regression testing against a controlled requirement baseline, execute them and sign the report, documenting results, defects, and compliance status to support regulatory submissions, inspections and audits
* Shape product requirements early with cross-functional teams so they're testable and traceable, and keep the traceability matrices that prove every requirement has verification behind it
* Contribute to risk identification and assessment, define adequate risk controls, and verify their implementation
* Apply a risk-based approach to verification strategy that keeps pace with agile development, prioritizing what gets tested and when so problems surface without waiting for a finished build
* Coordinate specialized testing with external test houses (EMC, electrical safety, environmental), owning the interface between our internal requirements and their verification activities
* Work with manufacturing to carry test requirements through design transfer, so quality, safety, and compliance hold as products move from development into manufacturing
* Support controlled device updates with the verification and risk-assessment evidence needed for regulatory sign-off


**Requirements**
 Must have:
   

  

* 5+ years in system verification of medical devices, including devices governed by the IEC 60601-1 series (for example IEC 60601-1-2 EMC)
* Proven work experience with testing and verification of complex embedded systems (electronics, firmware, software, integrated sensors...)
* Track record designing verification test methods from scratch, defining test setups and acceptance criteria, especially where no existing standard method covers the requirement
* Experience contributing to risk assessment under ISO 14971 as a continuous part of product development
* Comfortable working across hardware, firmware, software, quality, regulatory, manufacturing, and external partner teams
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in engineering or a related technical field
* Documentation another engineer can follow: protocols and reports that hold up without you in the room. Professional English.


**Nice To Have**
* Familiarity with regulatory frameworks such as FDA and MDR
* Experience developing automated tests


 Experience designing test rigs for reliable and repeatable testing
   

  

**Why this role matters**
 Verification is what makes a scan trustworthy. Someone gets told about a mole, a blood pressure reading, a heart signal, and they act on it, so getting it right is the whole job. Here that's a discipline with its own strategy, not a checkbox, and as the senior voice in it you set the method rather than execute someone else's protocol. You're in the room when requirements are written and sitting alongside optics, electronics, firmware and mechanics design engineers, manufacturing engineers, and clinical colleagues in one Stockholm office, so problems get caught and solved the same day, not months later.
