As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications regardless of race and ethnicity, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, as well as socioeconomic, cultural, and religious background. We are committed to ensuring a respectful and inclusive recruiting process and workplace for everyone.*

title: DevOps Engineer, Engineering Excellence
description:
**Make excellent engineering the easy path, for every squad at If CTP**
 If is the biggest insurance company in the Nordics: thousands of skilled colleagues keeping everyday life running for millions of customers, their homes, cars, businesses and more. Behind that promise stands modern engineering, and behind our engineers stands Engineering Excellence: a DevOps-oriented enablement team whose product is the capability of every other squad. We are now looking for a DevOps Engineer who wants to build shared platforms, coach fellow engineers, and shape safe, human-approved agentic AI ways of working.
   

  

**About The Role**
 This is not a feature-delivery seat, it is a multiplier role. Instead of shipping one product, you make many squads better at shipping theirs, and your definition of done includes adoption: work is finished when another team can use, own and support it.
   

  

**Day To Day, You Will**
* Build and evolve our shared engineering backbone: reusable CI/CD pipelines and pipeline libraries, repository practices, platform tooling, integrations and automation on Azure and Azure DevOps.
* Establish and enable engineering standards, guardrails, and branching and naming conventions that make the right way the easy way.
* Strengthen quality and security: validation and testing enablement, software scanning, secure-engineering practice, reliability, and actionable engineering feedback.
* Untangle material cross-squad blockers in builds, environments, delivery and platform, making dependencies visible and handing over responsibly.
* Coach engineers and squads, support onboarding, and turn hard-won knowledge into documentation people actually use.
* Use engineering metrics, discovery and evidence to guide continuous improvement, without overstating what the data proves.


 You will also be hands-on in our agentic engineering journey. We are building an AI-assisted operating model for the team that starts deliberately read-only and follows a strict loop: agents observe and propose, humans approve, and only then are changes applied. You will help design these proposal-controlled workflows, the guardrails and least-privilege access behind them, and the evidence that shows what AI adoption genuinely improves.
   

  

 You will work across every squad rather than inside one, side by side with architects, squad technical leads, Product Management and program stakeholders. It is a rare vantage point that grows your platform depth and your influence at the same time. The team runs on Kanban flow rather than sprints: demand is clarified, work is made ready, delivered, validated, documented and handed over, with blockers made visible instead of hidden.
   

  

**We offer**
**Benefits**
 In the same way that we place high demands on you as an employee, we also expect you to place high demands on us as an employer. Here are some of the benefits of working at If:
   

  

* Career and development opportunities in the biggest insurance company in the Nordics
* Social activities, as well as highly skilled professional environment
* An including work environment where everyone is welcome
* Possibility of hybrid workplace
* Health promoting workplace with e.g., wellness allowance and various sports activities
* Great insurance benefits


**About The Team**
 Engineering Excellence is six engineers with one shared conviction: great enablement means the job is not done until someone else can use, own and support the outcome. We prefer evidence over assumptions, we make dependencies and risks visible instead of hiding them, and we keep egos low and trust high, coaching each other the same way we coach the squads.
   

  

 Human accountability sits at the core of how we adopt AI: our agents may observe and propose, but people approve, and decision rights always stay with the roles that own them. If’s whole business is keeping promises when it matters most, and we hold our engineering to the same standard, reliable, secure, and easy to build on. We also live If’s customer-centric, “undifficult” mindset internally: our customers are If’s own squads, and our job is to make their best work feel effortless. You will join an international workplace that is genuinely committed to diversity, and a team where your questions on day one are as welcome as your improvements on day one hundred.
   

  

**Who are you?**
 You are an enabler at heart, you get real energy from making other engineers faster, safer and more confident. You communicate clearly and coach as naturally as you commit code. You are curious and evidence-driven: you would rather measure than assume, and you separate facts from interpretation. When dependencies tangle and priorities shift, you stay calm, make the situation visible, and keep the flow moving. You treat documentation and handover as part of the craft rather than an afterthought. And whenever automation or AI touches real systems, you exercise sound judgement about access, privacy, least privilege and human approval.
   

  

**You Also Have**
* Practical experience in DevOps, platform engineering, developer productivity or engineering enablement
* Hands-on skills in CI/CD, Git, repository management, automation and pipeline engineering
* Experience with Azure and/or Azure DevOps
* A track record of improving quality, testing, security scanning, reliability or engineering standards
* Comfort working in a flow-based / Kanban way, with dependencies, blockers and explicit handover


**It’s a Plus If You Also Bring**
* Development experience in .NET, Java, Kotlin or TypeScript, or full-stack curiosity
* Experience with agentic or AI-assisted development, and with measuring its adoption responsibly
* Work with DORA or other engineering metrics, discovery or maturity assessments
* Experience building pipeline libraries, reusable templates or repository governance at scale


**Additional Facts And The Recruitment Process**
**Application deadline:** 
 Screening and interviewing will start immediately. However, application deadline is 14th of October.
   

  

**To apply for the position:** 
 Please attach your CV.
   

  

**Work location:** 
 Bergshamra
   

  

**Start:** 
 By agreement
   

  

 For more information, please contact Burhan Öcüt, DevOps Architect, burhan.ocut@if.se
   

  

 Background checks may be conducted as part of the recruitment process in accordance with applicable legislation and internal policies.
   

  

**We look forward to your application!**

title: Platform Engineer
description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a workplace where you are empowered to shape your career in the way you envision, where you become part of a supportive and inspiring community of engaged colleagues around the world, and where you have the opportunity to redefine what is possible. Our Cloud & Custom Applications teams focus on developing tailored, scalable, and secure cloud applications, integrating IT systems, and driving business transformation. AI is a key technology in everything we do and a central part of how we design and build modern systems and solutions. Intelligent AI-driven ways of working and technologies such as Agentic AI are accelerating innovation and shaping the future. Join us and help shape the next generation of systems together with world-leading organizations, while contributing to unlocking the full potential of technology in a more sustainable and inclusive world.
   

  

**Your Role**
 As a Platform Engineer Specialist at Capgemini, you will help clients design, build, and operate secure, scalable, and self-service platform solutions. You will combine hands-on engineering with platform strategy, automation, developer enablement, governance, and operational excellence.
   

  

 Platform Engineering is becoming one of the most important disciplines in modern software development. Organisations are investing heavily in developer platforms, cloud-native technologies, automation and AI-enabled engineering to help teams deliver software faster, more securely and at greater scale. We are growing our Platform Engineering capability across Sweden and are looking for Platform Engineers and Senior Platform Engineers who want to help clients solve complex engineering challenges, modernise software delivery and build platforms that enable hundreds, and sometimes thousands, of developers.
   

  

 This is a client-facing consulting role where you will combine hands-on engineering with architecture, automation, platform strategy and developer enablement. You will work with leading organisations across multiple industries, helping them establish modern platform capabilities that accelerate innovation while maintaining high standards for security, reliability and governance.
   

  

 This is a client-facing consulting role, and your work setup may vary between hybrid, onsite, or client-based engagements depending on the assignment. You can be based in Stockholm, Gothenburg, Helsingborg, Malmö, Växjö, or Älmhult.
   

  

**In this role, you will play a key part in:**
* Design, build, and operate cloud-native platforms across Azure, AWS, GCP, Kubernetes, and OpenShift, enabling modern delivery through CI/CD, self-service tooling, and internal developer platforms.
* Developing golden paths, reusable templates, platform APIs, and service catalogues that make it easier for engineering teams to build, deploy, and operate services.
* Driving automation and Infrastructure as Code using tools such as Terraform, Bicep, Pulumi, CloudFormation, Python, PowerShell, or Bash.
* Establishing platform standards, reference architectures and governance including platform security, identity and access management, observability, monitoring, and operational excellence.
* Support clients in moving AI initiatives from experimentation to secure, scalable, production-ready solutions.


**Your profile**
* Hands-on experience in platform engineering, DevOps, DevSecOps, cloud engineering, site reliability engineering, or a closely related field.
* A strong understanding of modern platform engineering principles and how self-service solutions can improve developer productivity and operational efficiency.
* Programming or scripting experience using Python, Go, C#, Java, TypeScript, or similar languages.
* Experience in applying security, governance, and responsible AI principles in an enterprise environment.
* Practical experience using AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, Amazon Q, Gemini Code Assist, or similar.
* A practical understanding of modern AI concepts and patterns, including LLMs, prompting, context engineering, RAG, evaluation, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop controls.
* The ability to combine strategic platform thinking with hands-on technical delivery in complex environments.
* Clear communication with technical teams and client stakeholders, and an interest in working in a consulting context.


*We do not expect you to know about every technology on this list. We are looking for strong engineering fundamentals, hands-on experience, and the ability to understand how infrastructure, software delivery, security, operations, and developer needs fit together*
**What We Believe You Will Enjoy About Working Here**
* Being part of a growing Platform Engineering capability where your expertise and ideas can make a visible impact.
* Working across diverse client environments, industries, technologies, and delivery models.
* Collaborating with skilled colleagues locally and globally, with access to strong technical communities and development opportunities.
* Contributing to initiatives within cloud, platform automation, developer enablement, and AI-assisted engineering.
* Helping clients build solutions that are secure, scalable, sustainable, and valuable in real business contexts.


**Application**
 We look forward to receiving your application. If you have any questions about the role or the recruitment process, please contact the responsible recruiter at Helene.yde@capgemini.com
   

  

*As part of our recruitment process, identity verification will be conducted through inspection of your ID card, and background checks may be carried out as required.*
 Capgemini is the business transformation partner for enterprises in the age of AI. We help organizations imagine and build an intelligent, sustainable future, combining AI, technology and human ingenuity to transform how they operate, innovate and grow. With unique end-to-end capabilities spanning strategy, technology, engineering and intelligent operations, we bring together deep industry expertise and market-leading capabilities in AI, cloud and data to turn ambition into measurable business outcomes at scale. Supported by a robust ecosystem of partners and nearly 60 years of expertise, Capgemini is a responsible and diverse global organization of over 410,000 team members in more than 50 countries. The Group reported 2025 revenues of €22.5 billion.

description:

The SPMO team is fully consumed by day-to-day partnership management and does not have in-house technical/automation skills to deliver on these commitments therefore we are looking for someone to support the team by building the operational tooling and automation layer that enables the partnership team to scale.
   

  

**What You'll Deliver**
 Phase 0 — Discovery & Process Audit (Weeks 1-2)
   

  

* Before building anything, the contractor must sit with the SPMO team and observe how the partnership is actually managed day-to-day.
* Shadow the team: Attend partnership meetings, observe how escalations flow through Slack channels, watch how SteerCo reports are assembled, see how the dependency tracker is maintained, understand how actions are tracked today
* Map current workflows: Document the missing processes (most are already documented) where information lives, how it moves, what the bottlenecks are, where manual effort is highest
* Stakeholder interviews: Short sessions with stakeholders to understand pain points from each perspective
* Audit existing tooling: Review current Google Sheets, Slack channel structure, existing dashboards, and any automation already in place
* Produce a discovery report: A short document summarising findings, confirming or adjusting the proposed deliverables, and presenting a detailed execution plan for the remaining weeks, reviewed and approved by the hiring manager before moving to implementation


 Phase 1 — Foundation (Weeks 2-5)
   

  

* Jira Project Setup & Cross-Instance Integration
* Design and configure a Jira project structure for The Partner-Bcom partnership management (action tracking, escalations, dependency management)
* Set up workflows, custom fields, dashboards, and automation rules tailored to cross-company collaboration
* Implement cross-instance linking between Booking.com's Jira and Etraveli's Jira instance enabling shared visibility on priority workstreams (technical escalations, search/cache, content issues) while maintaining clear internal-only vs. shared boundaries
* Migrate existing action tracking from Google Sheets to Jira with automated deadline flagging and status notifications
* Create role-based views: partnership team operational view, leadership/SteerCo strategic view, workstream-specific views
* Shared KPI / Metrics Dashboard
* Build an sharable dashboard with key partnership KPIs (delivery reliability, escalation volume/resolution, SLA compliance, dependency tracking metrics)
* Pull data from existing sources (Google Sheets trackers, Slack channels, Jira, pdf reports)
* Design for both internal and partner-facing versions with appropriate data boundaries


 Phase 2 — Intelligence Layer MVP (Weeks 5-10)
   

  

* Escalation Analytics & Cross-Channel Monitoring (MVP)
* Build a monitoring system across 40+ joint The Partner-Bcom Slack channels that detects issues, classifies by type (technical / commercial / CS / content / financial) and severity
* Implement keyword and pattern detection for signals that indicate problems not yet formally escalated (outages, impact mentions, spike discussions, blocking issues)
* Monitored channels, keywords, and severity thresholds must be configurable via a Google Sheet the team can edit without touching code
* Use LLM APIs via Booking.com GenAI Gateway (Claude / Gemini) for classification and summarisation — not custom ML model training.
* MVP scope: monitoring + alerting + weekly summary.
* SteerCo Report Assembly Automation (MVP)
* Build a report assembly workflow that pre-populates SteerCo and QBR templates from dashboards, trackers, and Slack channel monitoring
* Auto-collect highlights and lowlights from partnership channels since the last report
* Generate a "what's missing / who hasn't contributed" checklist
* Template structure and data sources configurable via Google Sheets so the team can adapt to changing report formats
* MVP scope: template pre-population + highlights collection. Narrative drafting and sensitivity screening deferred.


 Phase 3: Documentation & Handover (week 11-13)
   

  

* Task-oriented team guides: step-by-step instructions for every change the team is likely to make (add a Slack channel, add a KPI, modify a Jira workflow, change an alert threshold, update a report template)
* CLAUDE.md project file in every code repository — documenting codebase structure, key files, dependencies, and common modification patterns so the team can use Claude Code to maintain and extend the code
* Configuration reference: where every tuneable setting lives and what it controls
* Architecture overview for any future developer engagement
* Knowledge transfer sessions with the SPMO team
* Recommendation document for evolution roadmap: what the MVPs could grow into, with effort estimates
* Design Principle: Built for AI-Assisted Maintenance
* The SPMO team (partnership managers, not engineers) must be able to evolve, tune, and extend all deliverables after the contractor engagement ends. The team has access to Claude Code, Gemini, and NotebookLM — meaning they can use AI to read, modify, and extend well-structured code, but they won't write code from scratch. This shapes every architectural choice:
* Booking.com tech stack: Build on the tools the team already has - Jira (project management + automation rules), Confluence (documentation + knowledge base), Google Workspace (Sheets, Docs, Slides, Calendar), Slack, and LLM APIs via Booking.com GenAI Gateway (provides access to Claude and Gemini). No external platforms the team does not have access to. All LLM calls must go through the GenAI Gateway — direct API calls to Anthropic or Google are not permitted.
* No-code/low-code where possible and Reserve custom code for where platform capabilities genuinely don't reach
* Configuration over code: Where custom code is needed, build a clear configuration layer (a Google Sheet or Confluence page that controls which channels are monitored, what keywords trigger alerts, severity thresholds, report templates, and data sources) so the team can easily edit the configs.
* Claude Code-friendly codebase: All custom code must be clean, well-structured, and thoroughly commented so the team can use Claude Code to understand, modify, and extend it. Include a CLAUDE.md project file documenting the codebase structure, key files, and common modification patterns.
* Documentation in Confluence: All handover documentation, runbooks, and architecture docs live in Confluence (not scattered Google Docs). Task-oriented guides: "how to add a new Slack channel to monitoring", "how to add a KPI to the dashboard", "how to change an escalation threshold".


**Required Skills & Experience**
 Must Have
   

  

* Process Discovery and Business Analysis — Ability to observe how a team works, map existing workflows, identify bottlenecks, and translate findings into an automation plan.
* Jira and Confluence Administration — Project setup, workflow design, custom fields, dashboards, automation rules in Jira. Confluence for documentation and knowledge management. Experience configuring Jira for cross-company or partner collaboration scenarios (shared visibility with access boundaries) strongly preferred.
* Slack API Development — Bot development, channel monitoring, message parsing, automated notifications. This is the backbone of the escalation monitoring system.
* Google Workspace Integration — Google Sheets, Docs, Slides, Calendar APIs and/or Google Apps Script. Most existing data lives in Google Workspace and the team will continue using it alongside Jira.
* Python or JavaScript/TypeScript — Solid scripting and integration development. Code must be clean, modular, and well-documented — the team will use Claude Code (AI coding assistant) to maintain and extend it after the engagement.
* LLM/GenAI Application Development — Practical experience building applications on top of large language model APIs (Claude, Gemini, or similar) for classification, summarisation, and content extraction. Applied AI engineering — not research or model training.


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Cross-instance Jira integration — Familiarity with Atlassian marketplace apps for Jira-to-Jira linking (e.g., Backbone Issue Sync, Exalate, Getint). If not already experienced, must be able to evaluate and implement during Phase 1.
* Dashboard and reporting tools — Experience building operational dashboards in Google Sheets, Looker Studio, or similar. Strong candidates may propose better approaches discovered during Phase 0.
* Prompt engineering — Familiarity with patterns for reliable LLM-based classification and extraction (Anthropic Claude API and/or Google Gemini API
* Slack Bolt framework or similar Slack app development frameworks
* Data migration — Experience moving operational data from spreadsheets to structured systems (Google Sheets to Jira) while preserving history and relationships
* Experience with AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) — understanding how to write code that non-engineers can maintain with AI assistance
* Strategic partnership, alliance management, or business operations context — helpful for understanding the team work during discovery but not required
* Experience in large-platform environments (Booking.com scale or similar) — useful but not essential for this scope


 Profile
   

  

* Seniority: Senior (5+ years of relevant experience in business automation, ops tooling, or technical consulting)
* Working style: Autonomous, structured, comfortable operating in ambiguity. This is a solo contributor role embedded in a non-technical team — you need to translate business requirements into technical solutions independently, communicate progress clearly, and manage your own priorities within the agreed framework.
* Stakeholder management: You will work primarily with the Booking.com partnership team (Director + 2-3 partnership managers) and will have some interaction with The Partner counterparts for the Jira integration and shared tooling. Comfort working in a cross-company environment is important.


***The payrate for independent contractors is 40-95 EUR/hr.***

title: Data Engineer

title: Ansible Automation Consultant
description:
**Ansible Automation Consultant** 




**Location:** 
 Solna, Stockholm, Sweden
 



**Start Date:** 
 12th October 2026
 



**End Date:** 
 11th December 2026
 



**Contract Type:** 
 Temporary (2 months)
 



**Work Style:** 
 Hybrid (minimum 2 office days per week, 40 hours per week)
 



  





 Role Purpose
 



 Deliver a temporary two-month automation assignment focused on SharePoint Server patching and associated maintenance activities. Design, develop, test, and implement automation using Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform to reduce manual effort and improve the consistency, reliability, and repeatability of patching procedures. Enable maintainable automation for on-premises SharePoint environments and transfer the required knowledge to the operational team.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 


* Develop and maintain Ansible playbooks for SharePoint Server patching and maintenance.
* Integrate the automation solution with the existing Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform environment.
* Implement appropriate validation, logging, error-handling, and rollback procedures.
* Document the solution and provide effective knowledge transfer to the operational team.
* Support testing, issue resolution, and the initial production implementation.
* Apply automation and source-control best practices throughout the assignment.
* Work with technical and operational stakeholders to confirm requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Ensure the delivered solution is repeatable, supportable, and suitable for ongoing maintenance.



  





 Tasks
 


* Assess the existing SharePoint patching and maintenance process and identify automation requirements.
* Design the automation workflow within the established Ansible Automation Platform environment.
* Create reusable Ansible playbooks supporting SharePoint and Windows Server maintenance activities.
* Configure validation checks, execution logging, failure handling, and rollback steps where applicable.
* Manage automation content using Git-based source control and agreed development practices.
* Test the automation thoroughly before supporting its initial production deployment.
* Troubleshoot technical issues and refine playbooks based on testing outcomes.
* Produce operating guidance and deliver practical knowledge-transfer sessions.



  





 Deliverables
 


* Tested and documented Ansible playbooks for SharePoint patching and maintenance.
* Integration of the automation solution with the existing Ansible Automation Platform.
* Implemented validation, logging, error-handling, and rollback capabilities where applicable.
* Testing evidence and support for the initial production implementation.
* Operational documentation and completed knowledge transfer for the support team.



  





 Authority / Accountability
 


* Own the technical design and implementation of the assigned Ansible automation solution.
* Recommend practical automation approaches and best practices within the agreed scope.
* Take responsibility for solution quality, test readiness, and clear technical documentation.
* Coordinate technical dependencies and escalate material delivery risks or blockers promptly.



  





 Requirements
 


* Relevant higher education in IT, computer science, engineering, or equivalent professional experience.
* Senior-level automation consulting experience, with approximately 6 to 9 years of relevant experience.
* Hands-on experience with Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform.
* Strong Ansible playbook design and development skills.
* Familiarity with Git-based source control and automation best practices.
* Experience documenting automation solutions and transferring knowledge to operational teams.
* Experience with Windows Server automation is beneficial.
* Experience with SharePoint Server administration and patching is beneficial.
* Fluent spoken and written English is mandatory. Fluent Swedish is highly desirable.



  





 Working Conditions
 


* Temporary two-month assignment from 12th October 2026 to 11th December 2026.

title: IT-Infrastrukturtekniker
description:
Är du en erfaren Infrastrukturtekniker som trivs med att arbeta brett inom drift, server, virtualisering och modern IT-infrastruktur?
   

  

 Tillsammans med vår kund söker vi nu en Infrastrukturtekniker som vill arbeta i en större och tekniskt bred IT-miljö. Här får du arbeta med både den dagliga driften och den fortsatta utvecklingen av infrastrukturen, med fokus på stabilitet, säkerhet och tillgänglighet.
   

  

 Du blir en del av ett infrastrukturteam där du arbetar tillsammans med andra tekniker och specialister och får möjlighet att vara med och utveckla både tekniska lösningar och arbetssätt.
   

  

**Om Rollen**
 Som Infrastrukturtekniker arbetar du med drift, förvaltning, felsökning och vidareutveckling av kundens IT-infrastruktur.
   

  

 Miljön består av flera olika plattformar och tekniker, och rollen passar dig som har en bred infrastrukturbakgrund och tycker om att arbeta med hela kedjan, från operativ drift och felsökning till förbättringar, modernisering och teknisk utveckling.
   

  

 Du kommer även att arbeta med mer komplexa incidenter och problem samt delta i projekt och förändringsinitiativ kopplade till infrastrukturen.
   

  

**Arbetsuppgifter**
* Drifta, administrera och vidareutveckla server- och infrastrukturmiljöer
* Arbeta med Windows Server, Active Directory och Group Policy
* Förvalta och utveckla virtualiserade miljöer
* Felsöka komplexa problem inom server, nätverk och infrastruktur
* Arbeta med behörigheter, patchning och säkerhetsrelaterade aktiviteter
* Hantera incidenter, problem och förändringar
* Delta i migreringar, uppgraderingar och andra infrastrukturprojekt
* Arbeta med övervakning och proaktivt förbättringsarbete
* Dokumentera tekniska lösningar och arbetssätt
* Samarbeta med andra infrastrukturspecialister, supportteam och övriga delar av IT


**Teknisk Miljö**
* Windows Server
* Active Directory och Group Policy
* VMware och andra virtualiseringsplattformar
* Nätverk och nätverkstjänster
* Microsoft Azure och hybridmiljöer
* PowerShell och automation
* Backup och återställning
* Övervakning och loggning


**Vem Vi Söker**
 Vi söker dig som har flera års erfarenhet av IT-infrastruktur och som är van vid att arbeta med drift och utveckling av större tekniska miljöer.
   

  

 Du har en bred grund inom Windows Server, Active Directory, virtualisering och nätverk och känner dig trygg med att självständigt felsöka mer komplexa tekniska problem.
   

  

 Vi ser gärna att du även har erfarenhet av automation och skriptning, exempelvis PowerShell, samt förståelse för hybrid- och molnmiljöer.
   

  

 Det är också bra att ha erfarenhet av Linux och Open Source, även om det inte är rollens huvudsakliga fokus. Erfarenhet av exempelvis Nutanix, databaser eller andra infrastrukturella plattformar är också meriterande.
   

  

 Du behöver inte ha arbetat med samtliga tekniker ovan. Det viktigaste är att du har en bred förståelse för IT-infrastruktur, är nyfiken på ny teknik och har lätt för att sätta dig in i nya miljöer.
   

  

 Som person är du lösningsorienterad, strukturerad och ansvarstagande. Du trivs med att arbeta både självständigt och tillsammans med andra och tycker om att lösa tekniska problem samtidigt som du bidrar till att utveckla miljön framåt.
   

  

**Rollen kräver mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.**
**Om CONSULTING It**
 När du börjar hos oss som konsult på CONSULTING it blir du en del av vår gemenskap. Du får dessutom kollegor runt om i Sverige! Du har en dedikerad konsultchef som stöttar dig och din utveckling. Vi hjälper dig hitta nya vägar genom att prova på nya roller och nya branscher, för oss är det viktigt att du trivs på din arbetsplats. Vi ser till att du hamnar på ett bra bolag under ditt uppdrag och att uppdragen ligger i linje med hur du vill utvecklas framöver. Oavsett vad det blir, står vi bakom dig hela vägen – i ditt nästa, nästa och nästa steg. Gå med i vårt team och ta del av en spännande och utvecklande arbetsmiljö!

title: Data Engineer – Oncology Analytics Platform
description:
RaySearch develops software that supports cancer treatment at hospitals and radiotherapy clinics worldwide.
   

  

 We are looking for a Data Engineer to work on RayIntelligence, an oncology analytics platform helping radiotherapy clinics turn data into actionable insights.
   

  

**About RayIntelligence**
 Radiotherapy clinics generate large amounts of clinical and operational data every day. Much of this information remains difficult to access, analyze, and act upon. RayIntelligence is designed specifically for radiotherapy clinics and brings together data from treatment planning systems, oncology information systems, and other clinical and operational sources.
   

  

 The platform supports everything from treatment workflow analysis, patient volumes, machine utilization, and resource planning to the analysis of treatment patterns and long-term patient outcomes. By making data more accessible and trustworthy, RayIntelligence enables clinics to better understand their operations, learn from past treatments, and continuously improve care.
   

  

 For healthcare analytics to be useful, clinics need confidence in the data they are using. Metrics must be calculated consistently, results must be understandable, and the path from source data to displayed insight must be possible to verify. The platform is already deployed at customer sites, and we are now focused on expanding both its analytical capabilities and its adoption across clinics worldwide.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The role spans data ingestion, integration, transformation, analytical data modeling, and the implementation of new analytics use cases.
   

  

 Working in healthcare brings unique engineering challenges. Data quality, traceability, reproducibility, validation, and risk management are important parts of how we develop software. While RayIntelligence is not a medical device, we apply many of the same engineering principles and quality practices used throughout RaySearch.
   

  

 Unlike internal analytics teams, we are building a product for environments where we do not operate the source systems ourselves. Development must therefore account for limited access to real-world customer data, variation between customer environments, and the need to build analytics that clinics can understand and trust.
   

  

 The platform currently focuses on analytics and reporting use cases, but future AI and machine learning capabilities are expected to build upon the foundations being developed today.
   

  

 RaySearch supports the use of modern AI-assisted development tools where appropriate, while maintaining the quality standards and engineering rigor required in healthcare software development.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Capture and integrate data from clinical and operational source systems
* Design, build, and maintain data ingestion and transformation pipelines
* Develop analytical data models supporting product capabilities and customer use cases
* Implement new analytics capabilities using SQL and Python
* Contribute to architecture and design decisions related to scalability, maintainability, and data quality
* Improve observability, traceability, and reliability across the platform
* Ensure that metrics, transformations, and data flows can be understood, tested, and verified
* Participate in validation, testing, and risk-management activities appropriate for healthcare software environments


**Technology Stack**
**Our Platform Includes Technologies And Programming Languages Such As**
* Python & SQL
* PostgreSQL & SQL Server
* dbt
* AWS
* CDC-based ingestion
* Apache Superset


**Your Profile**
 We believe successful candidates will typically have experience in several of the following areas:
   

  

* SQL development
* Python development
* Data engineering and ELT/ETL development
* Data modeling and data warehousing, experience designing analytical data models based on complex operational systems with many entities, relationships, and business rules
* Experience applying software engineering best practices to data platforms and production systems
* Translating product and analytical requirements into robust technical solutions
* Working with data quality, observability, testing, or traceability in production data systems
* Formal education in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field is beneficial. Equivalent practical experience is equally valued
* Seniority is typically demonstrated through several years of professional experience designing, building, and operating production data systems


**Our Culture**
 At RaySearch, we share a passion for innovation and the fight against cancer. Our team consists of dedicated experts who strive to deliver exceptional results through collaboration, attention to detail, and cutting-edge technology. We take pride in our role as a leader in cancer treatment, developing solutions that truly make a difference for patients worldwide.
   

  

**Our Offer**
 We offer a dynamic and inclusive work environment in Hagastaden, Stockholm’s Life Science Hub. Our modern office space includes an in-house gym, yoga classes, and social activities such as ping pong, table football, and after-work events. We also provide a fantastic lunch buffet, daily fika, and a stunning rooftop terrace with a 360-degree view of Stockholm. This comes with a competitive compensation and benefits package.
   

  

**Application**
 Please apply for the position through the application form below. We do not accept applications via e-mail.

title: Technical Account Manager till Stockholm
description:
Är du en driven och engagerad person med ett intresse för IT? Motiveras du dessutom av att lösa utmaningar och arbeta med andra tekniskt kunniga kollegor? Hos Nordlo Advance får du komma till en arbetsgivare med stabil grund där du får möjlighet att utveckla dina tekniska kompetenser! Låter det intressant? Skicka in din ansökan redan idag!
   

  





**Om tjänsten**




 Vi söker dig som vill arbeta med flera av våra större kunder där du blir en självklar del av kundens IT och deras resa framåt.
   

  





 Vi söker dig som vill vara en tydlig rådgivare till våra kunder. Du arbetar operativt och strategiskt, både i vardagen samt är en del av kundens resa och planerar deras IT framåt.
   

  





 Som TAM (Technical Account Manager) ansvarar du för att främja en god kunddialog tillsammans med kundteamet och sköta drift samt utveckling av kundens miljö som ofta innehåller servrar, nätverk, datorer, databaser etc.  
   

  





 Utöver det dagliga arbetet som TAM ser vi också att du ingår i Nordlo Advance projektteam som hantera migreringar av nya kunder samt hanterad eskalerad problem och incidenter.
   

  





**Arbetet innebär** 



* Vara primär teknisk kontaktperson för strategiska kunder.
* Ansvara för teknisk förvaltning och kontinuerlig utveckling av kundernas IT-miljöer.
* Implementera tekniska lösningar och delta i förändringsarbete
* Hantera eskalerade incidenter och komplex felsökning.
* Samarbeta med Service Desk & interna specialister för att säkerställa hög kvalitet i leveransen
* Identifiera nya tekniska och affärsmässiga möjligheter hos kunden.
* Dokumentera, rapportera och säkerställa uppfyllnad av SLA och KPI.



**Mål för rollen**




 Säkerställa hög kundnöjdhet, driva proaktiva förbättringar, bidra till långsiktiga kundrelationer och vara den självklara tekniska rådgivaren genom hela kundlivscykeln.
   

  





**Om dig**




 Har social kompetens och tycker om att ta eget ansvar. Har flytande kunskaper svenska och engelska då daglig kommunikation sker i språken.
   

  





 Som person ser vi även att du är initiativtagande och inte räds för att ta egna beslut. Du har utöver det ett påtagligt teknikintresse och drivs av att lösa utmaningar utan tydliga ramar och riktlinjer. Vidare ser vi det som viktigt att självständigt kunna driva sitt arbete framåt och att du har god förmåga att prata med kunder och ge god service. 
   

  





**Tekniska kvalifikationer** 



* Djup förståelse för IT-infrastruktur, nätverk, säkerhet och hybridmiljöer.
* Mycket god kunskap inom Microsoft 365: Exchange, Teams, Intune, Azure, Active Directory, Purview och Entra ID
* Mycket god kunskap inom Windows Server (2019/2022/2025), Active Directory (AD DS, ADSI, ADMT, ADFS), Group Policy (GPO), DNS, DHCP, Remote Desktop Services (RDS), Microsoft Exchange, Microsoft SQL Server, PKI.
* Erfarenhet av virtualisering (VMware vSphere/Hyper-V…..)
* Erfarenhet av migreringar från On prem miljö till Microsoft 365 & Azure
* Kunskap om GDPR, ISO 27001 och NIS2.
* Vana att arbeta enligt ITIL-processer.



**Erfarenhet** 



* Minst 5 års erfarenhet i en kundnära teknisk roll.
* Erfarenhet av projektleveranser och teknisk förvaltning.
* Van att presentera komplex teknik för både tekniker och beslutsfattare.



**Din framtida arbetsgivare**




 Nordlo är en ledande aktör inom moln och infrastruktur. Vi erbjuder skalbara driftlösningar och full outsourcing av IT- och digitaliseringstjänster till företag och offentliga verksamheter. Genom nära samarbete och med ansvarsfulla val av innovativ teknik hjälper vi våra kunder växa säkert och hållbart i en samtid som förändras varje dag.
   

  





 Nordlo omsätter 2,5 miljarder SEK, har ca 1000 anställda på orter över hela Sverige och stora delar av Norge.
   

  





 Nordlo strävar efter att skapa en inkluderade arbetsplats med branschens mest engagerade medarbetare. För oss är mångfald och inkludering avgörande för att driva innovation och tillväxt. Vi arbetar aktivt för att attrahera talanger med olika bakgrunder och skapa möjligheter för våra medarbetare att växa.
   

  





*Är du vår nästa Technical Account Manager? Tveka inte på att skicka in din ansökan redan idag. Ansökningar hanteras löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.*




 Vill du veta mer? På vår hemsida kan du läsa om vår verksamhet, kundcase och våra medarbetare.

title: Chief Enterprise Architect, Advanced AI
description:
**Job ID: 6151**
 Welcome to Group Technology. Here, we bring business and technology together to shape Nordea’s future and turn ambitious ideas into practical, sustainable solutions. Through strong architecture leadership and close collaboration, we help create clarity, connect perspectives and support meaningful transformation across the bank.
   

  

 We are looking for a Chief Enterprise Architect, Advanced AI, who is excited to help shape the enterprise architecture and AI direction behind Nordea’s strategic ambitions. In this highly influential role, you will bring people together around a shared direction and help turn emerging possibilities into secure, scalable and valuable outcomes. This is a full-time permanent position.
   

  

 Nordea is a place where traditions meet tomorrow. We're not just a bank, we're a tech employer on a mission to evolve finance securely and responsibly. Together, we impact millions of people’s daily lives by ensuring they can access our solutions anytime, anywhere, while safeguarding their personal data and wealth. Join us in making an impact on the banking industry.
   

  

**About Our Team**
 Meet the Cross Architecture & Transformation team. We are a collaborative group with a shared ambition: to make Nordea’s enterprise-wide architectural direction clear, connected and actionable. By bringing business and technology perspectives together, we help translate strategic ambitions, regulatory needs and technology evolution into outcomes that support better customer experiences, operational excellence, compliance and innovation.
   

  

 Our work sits at the crossroads of strategy, business transformation, governance and technology. You will join experienced enterprise architects and specialists across AI, information, application, technology and business architecture, governance and enterprise tooling. Together with senior leaders, architects and transformation teams, you will have the opportunity to build relationships, exchange perspectives and influence decisions that matter across the entire bank.
   

  

**In this role, you will have the opportunity to:**
* Shape enterprise architecture and AI strategies, working side by side with business and technology teams to create practical adoption roadmaps.
* Create clear architecture principles, reusable patterns and governance standards that make responsible AI adoption and application modernisation easier to scale.
* Turn business priorities and customer needs into clear technology and architecture direction aligned with Nordea’s 2030 strategy, risk appetite and regulatory requirements.
* Help build scalable and well-governed architecture for predictive, generative and agentic AI, bringing fragmented initiatives together as reusable enterprise capabilities, platforms and services.
* Champion AI architecture that is secure, private, explainable, traceable, resilient and responsible.
* Lead simplification and rationalisation across Nordea’s application, technology and platform estate.
* Support major transformation, modernisation and platform initiatives from strategic direction through implementation.
* Bring business, technology, data, engineering, security, risk and compliance together around shared decisions and outcomes.
* Share your expertise and help architects and platform teams grow through architecture reviews, technical deep dives, technology evaluations and hands-on implementation guidance.


**Who You Are**
 You may be a great fit for this role if you are a strategic and technically credible architecture leader who enjoys turning enterprise architecture and AI into meaningful business value. You combine long-term vision with a practical mindset and believe that good architecture should help people move forward. You are equally comfortable contributing to executive conversations, shaping strategy and exploring technical detail with experts.
   

  

* See the bigger picture while staying connected to technology and the realities of implementation.
* Explore emerging AI technologies with curiosity and sound judgement, balancing value, risk and long-term impact.
* Make complex business, architecture and AI topics clear, relevant and actionable for different audiences.
* Build trusted relationships across business, technology, data, risk and regulatory functions, even when priorities differ.
* Challenge established thinking respectfully, make difficult decisions when needed and protect the principles and controls that matter.
* Create momentum through influence, collaboration and clear communication, while helping people and the wider architecture community grow.


**We hope you bring:**
* Senior enterprise architecture leadership: At least 10 years of enterprise architecture experience, including work as a Chief Enterprise Architect, Head of Enterprise
* Architecture or equivalent senior architecture leader in a large, complex organisation.
* Financial services or regulated-industry expertise: Extensive experience in banking, insurance, pensions, wealth management or another highly regulated environment, with strong understanding of governance, risk, compliance, security and data privacy.
* AI strategy and architecture: Demonstrated ability to define AI strategies and adoption roadmaps, align initiatives with business objectives and establish architecture and governance for responsible AI.
* Advanced AI knowledge: Strong understanding of large language models, generative AI and agentic AI, including secure integration, governance and scaling in a regulated environment.
* Transformation leadership: Proven leadership in large-scale transformation, application modernisation, platform simplification or technology rationalisation.


**Your perspective on advanced AI**
 You bring a broad understanding of enterprise AI architecture and enjoy helping others make thoughtful choices across AI strategy and roadmaps; predictive, generative and agentic AI; retrieval-augmented generation and enterprise knowledge grounding; multi-agent orchestration and routing; governed AI platforms; integration and data architectures; observability and auditability; responsible AI; security, privacy and regulatory compliance; cloud and hybrid-cloud strategies; lifecycle and cost management; and reusable patterns and guardrails. Just as importantly, you recognise that sustainable AI is built on strong data, integration, security, ownership, governance and an operating model that supports the full AI lifecycle.
   

  

**We would also value:**
* Deep cloud architecture expertise, preferably in Microsoft Azure or AWS, including hybrid and regulated cloud environments.
* A TOGAF certification or an equivalent recognised enterprise architecture qualification.
* Hands-on experience establishing enterprise AI reference architectures, reusable AI patterns or governed AI platforms.


**What You Can Help Us Achieve**
* A clear enterprise architecture and AI strategy aligned with Nordea’s business and technology ambitions.
* Actionable AI adoption roadmaps co-created with business and technology teams.
* Scalable, governed and secure AI capabilities connected to measurable business outcomes.
* Stronger alignment between strategy, investments and architecture direction, with reduced complexity across the technology estate.
* Improved architecture decision-making, successful modernisation initiatives and effective implementation support for architects and platform teams.
* A strong, collaborative architecture community that delivers measurable enterprise value.


 This is an opportunity to shape more than architecture. You will help influence how Nordea uses technology and AI to transform its business, support its customers and deliver its long-term strategy—while working with talented colleagues who value collaboration, curiosity and responsible execution. If you are inspired by the possibility of turning enterprise architecture and AI into practical direction, scalable capabilities and measurable value, we would be very happy to hear from you.
   

  

**What We Offer**
 Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us.
   

  

**People** 
 are driven by many different factors. For some, it’s to take their career to the next level. For others, it’s to break new ground within their area of expertise – in other words, with us, you will always move forward.
   

  

**A culture** 
 that fosters performance and growth in one of the largest Nordic banks, offering various opportunities to evolve, develop and learn from brilliant colleagues with diverse backgrounds in a vibrant working environment.
   

  

**Hybrid working model** 
 – we believe in the value of bringing people together and at the same time we embrace the freedom of flexibility.
   

  

**Diversity and inclusion** 
 are a natural part of our daily work. We know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable one. We genuinely believe that our diverse backgrounds, experiences, characteristics and traits make us stronger together. Every day we strive to find new ways to improve diversity and inclusion within our community e.g. we have signed the European Diversity Charters in the countries where we operate to show our commitment and engage with others to continue learning and improving.
   

  

 If this sounds like you, get in touch!
   

  

**Next steps**
 Submit your application no later than 21/09/2026. For more information, you’re welcome to contact Lina Gustafsson at lina.gustafsson@nordea.com.
   

  

**The recruitment process consists of the following steps:**
* Preliminary CV selection
* Online interview with the hiring leader and HR
* Background check


**We enable dreams and aspirations for a greater good.**
**We build relationships.** 
 We add a personal touch to everything we do – when advising our customers, collaborating with colleagues, and meeting our potential candidates.
   

  

**We learn and develop.** 
 We take pride in being experts and thinking ahead. We use our expertise to meet our customers’ needs, from the simplest to the most complex. We bring a growth mindset to our work that enables us to focus on a broader perspective in our daily challenges.
   

  

**We lead change.** 
 We are responsible and aware of the impact of our decisions, both for our customers and for our local and global communities. Mindful of our responsibility towards current and future generations, we have made sustainability an integrated part of our business strategy.
   

  

**We are Nordea.** 
 We have a 200-year history of supporting and growing the Nordic economies and our values are deeply rooted in these open, progressive and collaborative societies. As one of the biggest employers in the Nordics, Poland and Estonia, you have excellent opportunities to evolve, develop and move forward with us. Studies show that members of underrepresented communities don’t apply for jobs unless they tick all the qualification boxes. If this is part of why you hesitate to apply, we would like you to reconsider and give it a chance. Maybe your profile fits our needs much better than you think.
   

  

**Only for candidates in Sweden:** 
 For union information, please contact Finansförbundet at finansforbundet@nordea.se or SACO at SacoNordea@nordea.com.

title: Staff Engineer | Consumer Domain
description:
**We're building tomorrow's delivery platform**
 At Instabee, we're on a mission to become the undisputed #1 delivery service in the eyes of our consumers. We need exceptional engineers to help us get there.
   

  

 We're looking for a Staff Engineer who can bridge the gap between ambitious business goals and technical execution. Someone who identifies opportunities, builds the right solutions, and raises the bar for everyone around them.
   

  

 The role
   

  

 You will be embedded in one of our Consumer teams, the part of Instabee that sits closest to real users and real deliveries. This is a hands-on role where you will spend most of your time building, not reviewing architectural slide decks. Your job is ensuring we're building the right things, in the right way, at the right scale.
   

  

 Aside from the work within the team, you will be part of a community of Staff Engineers working on cross-organisation projects and challenges.
   

  

 You'll help translate business ambition into engineering execution, surface hard problems before they become expensive ones, and actively drive the engineering culture at Instabee by raising the bar, sharing knowledge, and making the organisation better at building software.
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

**Ship things users notice** 
 Identify and build features that move the needle on user satisfaction. You'll own problems from idea to production, together with your team.
   

  

**Keep the team unblocked** 
 Spot friction before it becomes a bottleneck. That might mean improving test setup, fixing a flaky deploy pipeline, or untangling a service boundary that's slowing everyone down.
   

  

**Make technical trade-offs explicit** 
 Help the team choose solutions that are good enough now and don't paint us into a corner later. Scale and velocity both matter, and your job is to hold both at once.
   

  

**Connect code to outcomes** 
 Help engineers understand why what they're building matters. Work with Product and Data to make sure our systems produce the signals we need to make good decisions.
   

  

**Raise the bar around you** 
 Coach engineers, share what you know, and push for a culture where we learn from mistakes instead of hiding them.
   

  

 What we're looking for
   

  

 You don't need to be an expert in everything your team touches, but you should care deeply about succeeding together as a team.
   

  

**You're a doer.** 
 You don't just think about problems; you solve them.
   

  

**You're a technical leader** 
 who has built web and app (ideally consumer facing) solutions at scale, and can move fluidly between deep technical dives and high-level architectural trade-offs.
   

  

**You're strategic and pragmatic.** 
 You know that perfect is the enemy of good. You favor iteration, deliver value early and often, and ship before you have the ideal solution.
   

  

**You're a communicator and collaborator.** 
 You make complex technical concepts accessible to non-technical partners and thrive in cross-functional environments where engineering, product, and business move together.
   

  

**You're a quality advocate** 
 who holds a high bar for stability and security, without killing the pace of innovation.
   

  

 If this sounds like the kind of challenge you'd wake up excited to tackle, we'd love to hear from you.
   

  

 What You'll Get
   

  

 We can promise you'll be challenged, develop your skills, and work with truly amazing and competent colleagues. If you like change and want to set new processes and ways of working — this is the place for you.
   

  

 Of course, we have all the standard benefits in place. But beyond that, we also offer:
   

  

**🌇 Sky-High Office —** 
 Modern and newly renovated with 360-degree views across Stockholm
   

  

**🐶 Puppy Friendly —** 
 Bring your dog to work (we've got a whole floor for our furry friends)
   

  

**🏓 Fun & Games —** 
 Ping pong, shuffleboard, foosball, and a karaoke room
   

  

**👶 Six Months Parental Pay —** 
 Step away and give your little one the care they deserve
   

  

**🎂 Your Birthday Off —** 
 Celebrate yourself with a day off each year
   

  

**⏰ Hybrid & Flexible —** 
 Work the way that works for you
   

  

 Our Commitment to You
   

  

 Diversity and inclusion are at the heart of who we are. We're committed to creating an inclusive work environment where everyone's perspectives are valued and every employee has the opportunity to thrive and reach their full potential.
   

  

*This role requires a background check via Svensk Bakgrundsanalys, which includes a review of public criminal records. The results are handled confidentially as part of our standard recruitment process in Sweden.*
 Ready to join us? We'd love to hear how you think about technical leadership and what excites you about solving logistics at scale.
   

  

 Instabee Group, with consumer-facing brands Budbee, Instabox, and Porterbuddy, brings together years of experience in delivery. Today, Instabee Group is present in five markets, serving thousands of online merchants and millions of consumers with seamless home deliveries and convenient parcel locker deliveries, using the best fuel available. With smart technology, a strong focus on sustainability, and a secure supply chain, Instabee has become a trusted partner for online merchants and a preferred choice for consumers.

title: Solution Architecture - SENIOR T24 ARCHITECT
description:
**Role:** 
 Solution Architecture - SENIOR T24 ARCHITECT
 



  





**Assignment Description:** 




 We are looking for an experienced Senior T24 Architect to help drive the evolution of a large and complex Core Banking environment. You will define and guide the architecture of our Temenos T24 landscape, ensuring that business capabilities, technology platforms and long-term strategic goals remain aligned. You will provide end-to-end architectural leadership across multiple initiatives and delivery streams. Working with business stakeholders, engineers, architects and external partners, you will support the stability and resilience of critical banking services while enabling platform modernisation and simplification. Your impact You will influence the long-term direction of Core Banking and help create scalable, resilient and maintainable capabilities that support customers and business teams across multiple markets.
 



  





**What you will be doing:** 




 • Lead Core Banking architecture
 



 • Shape and evolve the architecture roadmap for Temenos T24 and surrounding Core Banking capabilities.
 



 • Define target-state architecture, principles and standards aligned with business and technology strategy.
 



 • Provide end-to-end architectural leadership across complex initiatives and delivery streams.
 



 • Ensure consistency, scalability and sustainability across the Core Banking landscape.
 



 • Design business-critical solutions
 



 • Translate business requirements into robust, implementable architecture solutions.
 



 • Design integrations between Core Banking, payments, digital channels, lending, deposits, customer management and data platforms.
 



 • Identify interfaces, data flows and dependencies across applications, infrastructure and external services.
 



 • Evaluate architectural alternatives and make clear trade-offs across business value, delivery risk and technical complexity.
 



 • Drive platform modernisation
 



 • Help modernise and simplify the Core Banking ecosystem while protecting service stability.
 



 • Promote API-first, event-driven and cloud-enabled architecture patterns where appropriate.
 



 • Reduce technology complexity and improve platform maintainability, testability and operability.
 



 • Identify opportunities for reuse, automation and standardisation across markets and delivery teams.
 



 • Build resilient, governed solutions
 



 • Define critical functional and non-functional requirements for availability, security, performance, scalability, resilience and operability.
 



 • Guide architecture reviews and ensure alignment with enterprise standards and regulatory expectations.
 



 • Build and maintain the architectural runway needed for sustainable delivery and future change.
 



 • Assess architectural risks, technical debt and lifecycle concerns, and guide proportionate remediation.
 



 • Collaborate and influence
 



 • Partner with business owners, Product and Solution Management, engineering teams, Enterprise Architects and external suppliers.
 



 • Act as a trusted advisor for strategic Core Banking initiatives and technology investment decisions.
 



 • Communicate complex architectural topics clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
 



 • Mentor architects and engineers, foster collaboration and enable accountable decision-making within teams.
 



**Required Experience Mandatory:** 




*Experience and domain knowledge* 




 • Significant experience with Temenos T24 / Temenos Transact in architecture, solution design or senior
 



 engineering roles.
 



 • Deep understanding of Core Banking processes, platform capabilities and integration dependencies.
 



 • A proven record of leading architecture for large-scale transformation, migration or modernisation
 



 initiatives.
 



 • Experience working across multiple teams, products or markets in a complex enterprise environment.
 



 • Banking experience involving demanding availability, security, resilience and regulatory requirements.-
 



 REST API, TypeScript, React, Angular, C#, Microsoft Azure
 



  





 Solution design, Financial services domain knowledge, Core Banking, Risk Assessment, Integration and
 



 Verification, Banking, Debt Collection,
 



**Language requirements** 




 English fluently

title: ServiceNow-utvecklare till Sopra Steria
description:
**Jobbeskrivning**
**Om Oss**
 Sopra Steria är Europas ledande konsultföretag inom ServiceNow och digital transformation. Vi hjälper företag och organisationer att effektivisera sina verksamheter genom innovativa teknologilösningar. Med fler än 4000 ServiceNow-experter besitter vi marknadens största och mest framstående ServiceNow-team där får du möjligheten att arbeta med dem mest spännande projekten samt utvecklas i en dynamisk och framåtlutad arbetsmiljö. Nu tar vi nästa stora kliv och satsar ännu hårdare på vår ledande position inom ServiceNow. Hos oss får du chansen att vara med och driva utvecklingen framåt, forma framtidens lösningar och göra verklig skillnad. Vill du vara en del av vårt ledande team?
   

  

**Om Rollen**
 Vi söker en driven ServiceNow-utvecklare som vill vara med och skapa skräddarsydda digitala lösningar för våra kunder. I denna roll kommer du att arbeta med utveckling, konfiguration och anpassning av ServiceNow-plattformen, med fokus på att effektivisera och automatisera affärsprocesser. Du kommer arbeta i teamleveranser tillsammans med experter som utvecklar innovativa lösningar baserade på ServiceNow och low-code-teknologier.
   

  

**Dina Arbetsuppgifter**
* Utveckla och konfigurera ServiceNow-applikationer och arbetsflöden.
* Implementera low-code/no-code-lösningar med hjälp av ServiceNow App Engine.
* Anpassa och optimera affärsprocesser genom automation och integrationer.
* Samarbeta med kunder och interna team för att identifiera och lösa affärsutmaningar.
* Följa best practices och säkerställa kvalitet i kod och konfiguration.


**För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du bör ha:**
* Minst 3 års erfarenhet av utveckling i ServiceNow eller andra low-code-plattformar.
* Kunskap i JavaScript och webbutveckling (HTML, CSS).
* Förståelse för olika ServiceNow-moduler och certifiering inom plattformen är starkt meriterande.
* Förmåga att analysera och förbättra affärsprocesser med hjälp av teknik.
* En stark vilja att utvecklas och arbeta i en konsultroll.
* Flytande svenska och engelska i tal samt skrift.


**Vi Erbjuder**
* En spännande arbetsmiljö hos Europas ledande ServiceNow-konsultbolag.
* Möjlighet att arbeta med innovativa lösningar och den senaste tekniken.
* Kompetensutveckling genom certifieringar, utbildningar och mentorskap.
* Hybrid arbetsmodell samt konkurrenskraftiga villkor och förmåner


**Om ServiceNow-teamet På Sopra Steria**
 Sopra Steria är Nordens ledande expert inom ServiceNow – vi har den största och mest specialiserade kompetensen på marknaden. Som ElitePartner till ServiceNow levererar vårt starka och sammansvetsade team omfattande och högkvalitativa lösningar, där flera av våra erfarna ServiceNow-konsulter samarbetar för att maximera värdet för våra kunder. Vi drivs av innovation, samarbete och kunskapsutbyte – tillsammans sätter vi nya standarder och skapar framtidens digitala lösningar. Vill du arbeta med de bästa? Då är Sopra Steria platsen för dig.
   

  

**Om Sopra Steria**
 Sopra Steria är en av Europas ledande aktörer inom digital transformation, med över 60 000 medarbetare i mer än 30 länder globalt. Vi driver innovation och hjälper företag och organisationer att effektivisera, utvecklas och skapa långsiktigt värde genom banbrytande teknologilösningar.
   

  

 Hos oss arbetar de främsta experterna inom sina områden i en dynamisk och framtidsorienterad miljö där samarbete, nytänkande och teknisk spetskompetens står i centrum.
   

  

**Ansökan**
 Om du är redo att ta nästa steg i din karriär och vara en del av vårt framstående team, ansök genom att ladda upp ditt CV. Kontakta gärna ansvarig rekryterare, Teodor Nellvik (teodor.nellvik@soprasteria.com) eller Business Owner Mikael Kroglund (mikael.kroglund@soprasteria.com), för eventuella frågor om tjänsten.
   

  

 På Sopra Steria ställer vi höga krav på både kompetens och säkerhetsmedvetenhet hos våra medarbetare. Innan en eventuell anställning kommer du därför att genomgå en bakgrundskontroll, och vid intervju behöver du kunna uppvisa giltig legitimation.
   

  

**Välkommen till Sopra Steria - där din kompetens formar framtidens digitala lösningar!**
**Ytterligare information**
 Sopra Steria är ett ledande internationellt konsultbolag inom digital transformation. Vi bygger samhället genom designdriven innovation, teknisk utveckling med kunskap om marknadens ledande plattformar och driftlösningar (managed services). Med modern teknologi och en gedigen affärsförståelse är vi en helhetspartner för våra kunder och deras digitala transformationsresa. Enligt Great Place To Work är vi en av Sveriges bästa arbetsplatser, vi har tilldelats utmärkelsen Karriärföretag flera år i rad och Gartner har listat oss som ett topp 5 bolag inom digital transformation.

title: Senior Security Engineer - SecOps
description:
**Why Mozilla?**



Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.



The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute **open-source** software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.


**About this team and role:**



Mozilla is looking for an Incident Responder to monitor and mitigate attacks across Mozilla’s products and services. In this position, you will be a part of a flexible team responsible for handling security incidents. As such, you’ll need to have years of practical security experience and knowledge of the state of the art for detecting and responding to attacks. You’ll be someone Mozillians across the company depend on and trust to respond quickly and effectively in a crunch, with the outstanding communication and collaboration skills needed to work in partnership with diverse stakeholders. Most importantly, you will become a critical member of the team responsible for ensuring the integrity of Mozilla’s products and for keeping Mozilla’s users safe, within a company dedicated to building a more secure internet.


**What you'll do:**
* Identify and respond to security incidents on a global scale.
* Act as an incident commander to drive incidents through the entire response lifecycle.
* Design and maintain a portfolio of security alerts, automated actions, playbooks and escalation workflows in support of a high-performing 24/7 incident response capability.
* Conduct threat hunting activities, anticipate future threats, and maintain forward-thinking strategies for tools/technology/processes that combat sophisticated threat actors.
* Research threat intelligence reports, triage and manage resulting workflows.
* Partner with key stakeholders and communicate effectively to maintain a continuously improving feedback loop of preparation, identification, analysis, containment, and post mortem activities.
* Participate in on-call rotation.

**What you'll bring:**
* 5+ years of demonstrated ability managing security incidents at a global scale and/or experience working in Security Operations Centers (SOC), Product Security Incident Response Teams (PSIRT), and Computer Security Incident Response Teams (CSIRT).
* Expertise with security information and event management (SIEM) systems (eg. ELK, Google BigQuery, Splunk, etc.). Splunk proficiency is preferred.
* Expertise with endpoint detection and investigation. Hands-on experience with leading EDR tools and demonstrated ability to leverage endpoint telemetry to find root cause.
* Expertise with security orchestration and automation (SOAR) platforms such as Tines or Splunk SOAR.
* Superb communication and leadership capacity; ability to partner effectively with diverse company stakeholders.
* Real-world experience in software development and/or engineering operations for consumer products and services; B.S. in a technology-focused field is helpful.
* Practical experience working with cloud technologies (eg. Google Cloud Platform, Amazon Web Services, Heroku, Microsoft Azure, etc.).

**Competencies:**
* Ownership and Accountability
* Autonomy
* High Level of Integrity
* Clear Communication
* Creative Problem Solver
* Passionate about Security


**What you’ll get:**


* Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
* Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
* Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
* Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
* One-time home office stipend
* Annual professional development budget
* Quarterly well-being stipend
* Considerable paid parental leave
* Employee referral bonus program
* Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)


**About Mozilla**



Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.


**Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging**



Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.



We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Please contact us at hiringaccommodation@mozilla.com to request accommodation.



We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race (including hairstyle and texture), religion (including religious grooming and dress practices), gender, gender identity, gender expression, color, national origin, pregnancy, ancestry, domestic partner status, disability, sexual orientation, age, genetic predisposition, medical condition, marital status, citizenship status, military or veteran status, or any other basis covered by applicable laws. Mozilla will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics or any other unlawful behavior, conduct, or purpose.

title: Google Cloud AI Engineer
description:
#### **Looking for a workplace for the future?**


At Telenor, you own your career. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to make the most of your dreams and expertise while contributing to technological innovations that are barely even imagined today. Innovations that we know will change the map for how we communicate and live our connected lives in the future.


We are now looking for **Strategic AI Developer / Google Cloud AI Engineer** to join our **AI & Automation team.**

##### **How you’ll make a difference with us**


As part of Telenor's Center of AI Acceleration, within Data & Analytics, you will help shape the future of AI across the company by designing, developing, and scaling innovative AI solutions that solve complex business challenges. As more of our data, analytics, and AI capabilities move to Google Cloud, you will play a key role in establishing and growing our expertise in Google's AI ecosystem, including Gemini, Vertex AI, and agent-based solutions.


In this role, you will work closely with business stakeholders, data professionals, architects, and developers to identify opportunities where AI can create real business value. You will design and build solutions ranging from generative AI assistants and intelligent automation to advanced multi-agent systems that support business processes across multiple functions. Key responsibilities include:

* Designing, developing, and deploying AI solutions using Google Cloud technologies such as Vertex AI, Gemini, and related services.
* Building generative AI and agent-based applications that improve customer experiences, employee productivity, and operational efficiency.
* Developing and orchestrating multi-agent solutions that automate complex business processes spanning multiple teams and systems.
* Collaborating with business units to transform ideas and use cases into scalable production-ready AI solutions.
* Contributing to AI architecture, development standards, best practices, and platform evolution.
* Sharing knowledge and helping grow Google AI capabilities


By helping Telenor harness the power of AI, you will contribute to delivering smarter services, faster problem resolution, and more personalized customer experiences, ultimately helping make our customers' lives safer, simpler, and more worry-free.

##### **Are you the one we’re looking for?**


We're looking for a curious and hands-on AI developer who is excited by emerging technologies and passionate about applying AI to solve real business problems.

**Must-have qualifications**

* Experience developing AI, ML, generative AI, or intelligent automation solutions.
* Experience with modern software development practices.
* Experience with cloud-native development on public cloud (Google Cloud preferred).
